definition_zh: 玩具；玩物；小人儿般的人；把……当儿戏
definition_en: an object for children to play with, or something treated as unimportant or childish
core_image: 小手里的拨浪鼓：只为了好玩而存在的东西
scene: 生日会后妈妈收拾客厅，孩子在纸箱旁举着刚拆出的礼物不肯撒手：孩子生日那天，爸爸送了他一个盒子，他拆开后欢呼着抱起里面的礼物跑向客厅，一整晚都在摆弄那个新 toy。
sceneCN: 这里 toy 是「玩具」（第 1 个义项：供儿童玩耍的物品）；句意是孩子拆开生日礼物，抱着玩具跑开。

collocations.zh: 随意考虑一个想法；不认真对待
小型示例问题；玩具问题

derivatives.zh: 由动词 toy 加现在分词构成，义为「摆弄；不认真对待」
由 toy 加 -like 后缀构成，义为「像玩具一样的；小巧精致的」

senses.title: An object children play with
senses.titleCN: 玩具；供儿童玩耍的物品
senses.definition: an object made for a child to play with
senses.definitionCN: 专为儿童玩耍而制造的物品
senses.example: The shelf is full of wooden toys from her grandmother.
senses.exampleCN: 架子上摆满了她祖母做的木制玩具。
senses.why: The core image is a small object held just for fun, which is exactly what a toy is.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象就是为了好玩而握在手里的东西，这正是玩具的本义。

senses.title: Something trivial or of little value
senses.titleCN: 无足轻重的东西；小玩意儿
senses.definition: something treated as unimportant, small, or merely for amusement
senses.definitionCN: 被当作不重要、微小或仅供消遣的东西
senses.example: The drone he built is just a toy compared with real aircraft.
senses.exampleCN: 他造的无人机和真正的飞机相比只是个玩具。
senses.why: Because a toy is for play rather than serious use, the word extends to anything not taken seriously.
senses.whyCN: 因为玩具只用于玩耍而非严肃用途，这个词延伸到任何不被认真对待的东西。

senses.title: To play with something idly
senses.definition: to consider or handle something casually without serious intention
senses.definitionCN: 漫不经心地对待或考虑某事，没有认真的意图
senses.example: She toyed with the idea of moving abroad for a year.
senses.exampleCN: 她随意考虑过移居国外一年的想法。
senses.why: Holding a toy means turning it over in your hands without commitment, so the verb means casual handling.
senses.whyCN: 拿着玩具意味着在手里翻来转去并不投入，所以动词表示随意的摆弄。

senses.title: A small person or doll-like figure
senses.definition: a person who is small or doll-like, often used in contrast with giants
senses.definitionCN: 矮小的人或像玩偶的人，常与巨人相对
senses.example: In the story the giant calls the sailors mere toys.
senses.exampleCN: 故事里巨人把水手们称为微不足道的小人儿。
senses.why: A doll is a tiny imitation person, so toy can name a person who looks as small.
senses.whyCN: 玩偶是人的迷你模仿品，所以 toy 可以指看起来同样矮小的人。

intro.en: Toy came into English in the late Middle Ages from Scandinavian sources, and its early meaning was amusement or playful behaviour before it settled on playthings.
intro.cn: toy 于中世纪晚期进入英语，一般认为来自斯堪的纳维亚语源，早期含义是「消遣、嬉戏」，后来才固定为「玩具」。

items.en: A Scandinavian word such as tuga or toge is usually cited as the source, meaning fun or play.
items.cn: 一般认为词源是斯堪的纳维亚语的 tuga 或 toge 一类词，意为「乐趣、玩耍」。

items.en: Recorded as toy meaning amusement, flirtation, or a trifle.
items.cn: 中古英语记作 toy，意为「消遣、调情或小玩意儿」。

items.en: The sense narrowed from any trifle to objects made for play.
items.cn: 词义从泛指小物件收窄为专供玩耍的物品。

items.en: The verb to toy with developed from the image of idle handling.
items.cn: 动词 toy with 从随手摆弄的画面发展出来。

items.en: The exact Scandinavian source word is uncertain; only the general origin is agreed.
items.cn: 确切的斯堪的纳维亚语源词不确定，学界只认同大致来源。

note.en: Words that look or sound close to toy, and words in the play field.
note.cn: 与 toy 形近音近的词，以及同属玩耍义场的词。

entries.definition: a source of protein made from soybeans
entries.definitionCN: 大豆蛋白制品；酱油，与 toy 只是拼写相近，词源完全不同
欢乐；喜悦，与 toy 押韵但来自法语词源
幼儿；小娃娃，与 toy 发音相近，义为小孩

entries.definition: a toy or something treated as an amusement
entries.definitionCN: 玩物；玩赏对象，与 toy 同义但更书面

entries.definition: an activity with rules played for fun
entries.definitionCN: 游戏；有规则的比赛，强调活动而非物品

entries.definition: a small model of a person for children
entries.definitionCN: 玩偶；布娃娃，toy 的一种具体类型

entries.definition: the state of finding something funny or entertaining
entries.definitionCN: 娱乐；消遣，抽象概念对应 toy 的早期词义

normalIntro.en: Break the word into its sound and picture the object itself.
normalIntro.cn: 把单词与它的发音和实物画面直接挂钩。

normal.en: toy sounds like a short, bouncy word, like a ball bouncing
normal.cn: toy 发音短促跳跃，像皮球弹跳的声音
常用搭配 toy car（玩具汽车）、toy store（玩具店）

normal.en: toy with = play with an idea casually
normal.cn: toy with＝不认真地考虑一个想法

normal.en: the toy aisle in a supermarket
normal.cn: 超市里的玩具货架是这个词最常出现的地方
toylike＝小巧可爱、不算数的感觉

abstract.en: A small bright object passed from hand to hand just for delight
abstract.cn: 一个明亮的物件在手中传递，只为快乐

abstract.en: Treating a real problem like a toy means you are not serious about it
abstract.cn: 把真问题当玩具，说明你并没认真

abstract.en: Hear the word bounce: toy, like a bouncing ball
abstract.cn: 听这个词弹跳起来：toy，像弹跳的球

examples.en: The child picked up his favourite toy and refused to go to bed.
examples.cn: 孩子拿起他最喜欢的玩具，不肯去睡觉。

examples.en: For years she toyed with the idea of writing a novel.
examples.cn: 多年来她一直随意考虑着写小说的想法。

examples.en: This small robot is just a toy next to industrial machines.
examples.cn: 和工业机器人相比，这台小机器人只是个玩具。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「tuo伊」——小孩举着玩具喊「拖一体」，想象一个玩具拼图被他拖着跑。拼写只有三个字母，别加 e。

root: 一般认为来自斯堪的纳维亚语源，早期指「消遣、嬉戏」，后固定为「玩具」。与 joy 只是押韵，词源无关。

sensesIntro.en: From the physical plaything, the word widens to anything trivial and to casual handling.
sensesIntro.cn: 从具体的玩具延伸到一切无足轻重之物，再到漫不经心的对待。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small object held just for fun
core.cn: 核心意象：只为好玩而握在手里的东西

branches.en: the physical object made for play
branches.cn: 供玩耍的具体物品

branches.en: anything too small or trivial to matter
branches.cn: 任何微小不足道的事物

branches.en: handling an idea without commitment
branches.cn: 不投入地摆弄一个想法

branches.en: when seriousness is missing, both a thing and an act become toys
branches.cn: 缺少认真时，物与行为都成了儿戏

branches.en: from a child's gift to an adult's trivial distraction
branches.cn: 从孩子的礼物到成年人的消遣

intro.en: Toy is a short borrowed word with no classical parts, so this section describes its word family instead.
intro.cn: toy 是简短的外来词，不含古典词缀，这里改述它的词族。

latinIntro.en: Toy has no Latin relatives; it entered English from Scandinavian sources.
latinIntro.cn: toy 没有拉丁同族词，一般认为经斯堪的纳维亚语进入英语。

items.exampleCN: 与成功擦肩而不认真对待

items.meaning: a maker or seller of toys

definition_zh: 轨道；足迹；踪迹；小路；追踪；跟踪
definition_en: a mark or line left by something that passed, or to follow such marks
core_image: 雪地里一串脚印：谁经过，地就记下谁
scene: 运动会清晨，选手们陆续进场，在环形跑道上做起热身：猎人蹲下身，用手指沿着雪地上一串清晰的足迹，一路望向树林深处刚留下的 track。
sceneCN: 这里 track 是「足迹」（第 1 个义项：经过者留下的痕迹）；句意是猎人顺着雪地足迹望向树林。

collocations.zh: 走在正确的路上；思路对头
忘了时间；忘记时间流逝

derivatives.zh: 由动词 track 加现在分词构成，义为「追踪；跟踪定位」
由动词 track 加 -er 后缀构成，义为「追踪者；追踪器」
由动词 track 加 -ed 构成，义为「被追踪的；有履带的」

senses.title: A mark or line left by a moving person, animal, or thing
senses.definition: marks or a line left on the ground by something that has passed
senses.definitionCN: 经过者在地面上留下的痕迹或压出的线
senses.example: The police followed the tracks in the snow to the cabin.
senses.exampleCN: 警察顺着雪地里的足迹追到小屋。
senses.why: The core image is the ground recording whoever passes, which is the literal track.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是地面记录下每一个经过者，这正是 track 的本义。

senses.title: A pair of rails or a course for racing
senses.definition: rails on which trains run, or a path prepared for racing
senses.definitionCN: 火车行驶的铁轨，或供赛跑用的专用跑道
senses.example: The high-speed train glides along the new track.
senses.exampleCN: 高速列车沿新轨道滑行。
senses.why: A line left by wheels hardened into rails, so a course for running kept the same name.
senses.whyCN: 车轮压出的线硬化成铁轨，赛跑的专用道沿用了同一个名字。

senses.title: A path or rough road
senses.definition: a rough path or road across country
senses.definitionCN: 野外 rough 的小径或道路
senses.example: They took a narrow mountain track to the village.
senses.exampleCN: 他们沿狭窄的山间小路走向村庄。
senses.why: Any line of repeated footprints becomes a path people reuse.
senses.whyCN: 反复踩出的脚印线自然变成人们重复使用的路。

senses.title: To follow someone or something by signs
senses.definition: to follow the movements of a person, animal, or object by finding evidence
senses.definitionCN: 通过线索跟随人、动物或物体的移动
senses.example: Scientists track the migration of birds by satellite.
senses.exampleCN: 科学家用卫星追踪候鸟迁徙。
senses.why: If a trail shows where something went, following the trail is tracking it.
senses.whyCN: 既然踪迹显示去向，顺着踪迹走就是追踪。

senses.title: To record and follow progress
senses.definition: to record and follow the development or position of something over time
senses.definitionCN: 持续记录并关注事物的发展或位置
senses.example: The app tracks how many hours you sleep every night.
senses.exampleCN: 这款应用记录你每晚睡了多少小时。
senses.why: Following physical tracks extends to following figures and changes on a screen.
senses.whyCN: 跟随实体踪迹延伸为跟随屏幕上的数据与变化。

intro.en: Track came into English in the late Middle Ages, generally assumed from Old French trac or a Germanic source, and originally meant a line or course drawn by something passing.
intro.cn: track 于中世纪晚期进入英语，一般认为源自古法语 trac 或日耳曼语源，本义是经过者拉出的线或路径。

items.en: The source is usually cited as Old French trac or a Germanic root meaning to draw or pull.
items.cn: 一般认为词源是古法语 trac 或日耳曼词根，意为「拉、拖」。

items.en: Recorded as a line or course, such as the course of a ship or animal.
items.cn: 中古英语记作轨迹、路径，如船只或动物的行进路线。

items.en: Extended to rails for vehicles and prepared running courses.
items.cn: 扩展到车辆铁轨和专门修建的跑道。

items.en: The verb developed the senses of following animals and, later, monitoring data.
items.cn: 动词发展出追猎动物、进而监测数据的义项。

items.en: The competing Old French and Germanic accounts are not finally settled.
items.cn: 古法语与日耳曼两种来源假说尚未有定论。

note.en: Words that look or sound close to track, and words in the pursuit field.
note.cn: 与 track 形近音近的词，以及同属追踪义场的词。

entries.definition: a small sign that something was present
entries.definitionCN: 痕迹；微量，与 track 拼写相近且同属痕迹义场，词源一般认为不同

entries.definition: a small nail or a change of direction
entries.definitionCN: 图钉；（船）转向，与 track 只是少一个字母

entries.definition: a clever act meant to deceive
entries.definitionCN: 诡计；戏法，与 track 发音相近，词源无关

entries.definition: a path or a line of marks left behind
entries.definitionCN: 小径；拖出的痕迹，与 track 近义但更强调拖拽痕迹
道路；小径，人工修建的通行路

entries.definition: to find someone or something by investigating
entries.definitionCN: 追查；查找，强调通过调查找到

entries.definition: a planned way from one place to another
entries.definitionCN: 路线；既定路径，强调规划而非痕迹

normalIntro.en: Link the sound to the mark left on the ground.
normalIntro.cn: 把发音与地面上留下的痕迹连起来。

normal.cn: 卡车（truck）驶过会留下轨迹（track），一音之差
常用搭配 on the right track（思路正确）
keep track of＝随时掌握动态
track record＝过往成绩单，赛跑道上的历史
铁轨与跑道是 track 的两个高频场景

abstract.en: See a line of footprints stretching across fresh snow
abstract.cn: 看见一串脚印横过新雪

abstract.en: Losing track of time is like losing the path you walked
abstract.cn: 忘了时间就像弄丢了走过的路

abstract.en: The train never leaves its track; stay on yours
abstract.cn: 列车从不出轨，你也守住自己的轨道

examples.en: The hunters found fresh tiger tracks near the river.
examples.cn: 猎人在河边发现了新鲜的老虎足迹。

examples.en: The radar system can track hundreds of planes at once.
examples.cn: 雷达系统可以同时追踪数百架飞机。

examples.en: After two wrong answers she was finally on the right track.
examples.cn: 答错两次之后，她终于思路对头了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「tracked」——想象卡车（truck）压过雪地，留下一条 track（轨迹）。truck 少个 r，track 少个 u，认准 ck 结尾。

root: 一般认为源自古法语 trac 或日耳曼词根「拉、拖」，本义为经过者拉出的线，后引申为轨道、小路和追踪行为。两种来源假说并列，未最终定论。

sensesIntro.en: From marks left on the ground, the word grew into rails, paths, following, and monitoring.
sensesIntro.cn: 从地面留下的痕迹生长出铁轨、小路、追踪与监测诸义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the ground remembering whoever passed
core.cn: 核心意象：地面记下每一个经过者

branches.en: the literal mark left by a passer-by
branches.cn: 经过者留下的实在痕迹

branches.en: rails and courses built along fixed lines
branches.cn: 沿固定线路铺设的铁轨与赛道

branches.en: a worn path reused by many feet
branches.cn: 众人重复踩踏而形成的小路

branches.en: following the signs to find the mover
branches.cn: 顺着线索追踪移动者

branches.en: from rails that guide a train to data that guides you
branches.cn: 从引导列车的铁轨到引导你的数据

latinIntro.cn: track 没有拉丁同族词，来源是古法语或日耳曼语。

definition_zh: 贸易；交易；行业；手艺；交换；做买卖
definition_en: the activity of buying, selling, or exchanging goods and services
core_image: 两手交换货物：你给我香料，我给你布
scene: 集市散场后，两个摊主还在为当天的生意盘算得失：码头清晨人声鼎沸，商人们忙着用茶叶交换刚运到的丝绸，一笔接一笔地完成每笔 trade。
sceneCN: 这里 trade 是动词「交易」（第 3 个义项：交换货物）；句意是商人们用茶叶交换丝绸。

derivatives.zh: 由动词 trade 加 -er 后缀构成，义为「商人；交易者」
由动词 trade 加现在分词构成，义为「贸易；交易活动」
由 trade 加 mark 构成，义为「商标」

senses.title: The business of buying and selling
senses.definition: the activity of buying and selling goods and services between people or countries
senses.definitionCN: 个人或国家之间买卖商品与服务的行为
senses.example: The port grew rich on the spice trade.
senses.exampleCN: 这座港口靠香料贸易致富。
senses.why: The core image is two hands exchanging goods, which is the root of all commerce.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是两只手交换货物，这是一切商业的根源。

senses.title: A particular business or craft
senses.definition: a job or skill, especially one learned by manual training
senses.definitionCN: 一种职业或技能，尤指通过手工训练学得的
senses.example: He learned the trade of carpentry from his father.
senses.exampleCN: 他跟父亲学了木工这门手艺。
senses.why: Trading goods is a skill like any other, so the word came to name skilled occupations.
senses.whyCN: 交易货物本身也是一门技能，于是这个词用于指称各门手艺。

senses.title: An act of exchanging
senses.definition: a single act of giving one thing to receive another
senses.definitionCN: 交出一件东西换取另一件的单次行为
senses.example: The two clubs completed a trade of players.
senses.exampleCN: 两家俱乐部完成了一次球员交换。
senses.why: One exchange of goods is one trade, just as one bargain is a trade.
senses.whyCN: 一次货物交换就是一笔 trade，与一次讨价还价相同。

senses.title: To buy and sell or exchange
senses.definition: to buy and sell things, or to give something in return for another
senses.definitionCN: 买卖货物，或交出某物换取另一样
senses.example: The family traded vegetables for salt at the market.
senses.exampleCN: 这家人在集市上用蔬菜换盐。
senses.why: Exchanging goods by hand is the verb form of the core image.
senses.whyCN: 用手交换货物正是核心意象的动词形态。

senses.title: To be bought and sold on a market
senses.definition: to be sold or bought at particular prices on a market
senses.definitionCN: 在市场上以特定价格被买卖
senses.example: The shares traded at a record high yesterday.
senses.exampleCN: 这些股票昨天以历史最高价成交。
senses.why: When goods meet a market, the market itself performs the exchange.
senses.whyCN: 货物进入市场后，由市场完成这场交换。

intro.en: Trade is a shortened form of Middle English trade path, a way one treads, from Old English tredan, to tread. The sense moved from a course of life to a habit, then to business.
intro.cn: trade 是中古英语 trade path（行走之路）的缩略形式，出自古英语 tredan（踏、行）。词义从人生道路转向惯常做法，再转向生意。

items.en: tredan meant to tread or step, the root of modern tread.
items.cn: 古英语 tredan 意为「踏、行走」，是现代 tread 的词根。

items.en: trade path meant a fixed way or course of life.
items.cn: 中古英语 trade path 指「固定路径或人生历程」。

items.en: Shortened to trade, meaning a habit or regular practice.
items.cn: 缩略为 trade，意为「惯常做法」。

items.en: The sense shifted to a craft and then to buying and selling as a regular practice.
items.cn: 词义转向手艺，再转向作为惯常活动的买卖。

items.en: Trade now covers commerce, crafts, exchanges, and market dealing.
items.cn: 现代英语中 trade 涵盖商业、手艺、交换与市场交易。

note.en: Words that look or sound close to trade, and words in the exchange field.
note.cn: 与 trade 形近音近的词，以及同属交换义场的词。

entries.definition: to step or walk on something
entries.definitionCN: 踩踏；行走，与 trade 同源（tredan），词义保留了「行走」本义

entries.definition: a small sign or to find by search
entries.definitionCN: 痕迹；追查，与 trade 拼写相近，词源不同

normalIntro.en: See trade as a path that merchants walk every day.
normalIntro.cn: 把 trade 看成商人每天走的「买卖之路」。

normal.en: trade contains tread: business is a path you walk
normal.cn: trade 里藏着 tread：生意是你走的路
常用搭配 trade in（以旧换新）、trade with（与……做生意）
trader＝做 trade 的人，即商人
free trade（自由贸易）与 fair trade（公平贸易）是高频词组

normal.en: the tourist trade, the drug trade
normal.cn: the + 行业 + trade 表示「某一行生意」

abstract.en: Two pairs of hands meet halfway over a table of goods
abstract.cn: 两双手隔着货物在桌前相遇

abstract.en: A trade is a road you walk so long it becomes your living
abstract.cn: 一条路走久了便成了你的营生

abstract.en: Hear trade rhyme with made: goods are made and traded
abstract.cn: trade 与 made 押韵：货既被造出，也被交易

examples.en: International trade between the two countries has doubled.
examples.cn: 两国之间的国际贸易翻了一番。

examples.en: She learned the trade from her grandfather, a watchmaker.
examples.cn: 她跟做钟表匠的祖父学会了这门手艺。

examples.en: The company trades in used cars and sells new ones.
examples.cn: 这家公司以旧车折价回收，同时销售新车。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「锤得」——想象商人在市场用锤子敲定交易：锤响了就得，这单 trade 成了。与 tread（踩踏）同根，都源自「走」。

root: 中古英语 trade path（行走之路）的缩略，出自古英语 tredan（踏、行）：固定的路 → 惯常的做法 → 手艺 → 买卖。

sensesIntro.en: From a walked path to a way of life, a craft, and finally the whole world of exchange.
sensesIntro.cn: 从踩出的路到人生历程、一门手艺，最终扩展到整个交换世界。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands exchanging goods across a table
core.cn: 核心意象：两手隔着桌子交换货物

branches.en: commerce as a whole between peoples
branches.cn: 人群之间的整体贸易

branches.en: a skilled occupation learned by practice
branches.cn: 通过实践习得的手艺

branches.en: one single act of exchanging
branches.cn: 单次交换行为

branches.en: people and markets performing exchanges
branches.cn: 人与市场进行交换

branches.en: a path walked so long it becomes a living
branches.cn: 一条路走久了便成了营生

intro.en: Trade is a native shortened compound with no classical affixes; this section describes its own family.
intro.cn: trade 是本土缩略复合词，不含古典词缀，这里描述其自身词族。

latinIntro.en: Trade has no Latin root; it descends from Old English tredan through tread.
latinIntro.cn: trade 没有拉丁词根，经由古英语 tredan 承接自「行走」一词。

giving up one thing to gain another

definition_zh: 传统；惯例；习俗；传说
definition_en: a custom or belief passed down within a group over generations
core_image: 祖母手里的旧年历：一代代照着过的日子
scene: 除夕夜全家围坐，长辈把传了三代的碗筷摆上桌：除夕夜全家围坐包饺子，奶奶笑着说这是家里一代一代传下来的老 tradition。
sceneCN: 这里 tradition 是「传统」（第 1 个义项：代代相传的习俗）；句意是除夕包饺子是家中三代相传的做法。

derivatives.zh: 由 tradition 加 -al 后缀构成，义为「传统的；惯例的」
由 traditional 加 -ly 构成，义为「传统上；惯例上」
由 traditional 加 -ism 构成，义为「传统主义」

senses.title: A custom passed down through generations
senses.definition: a belief or custom handed down within a society from generation to generation
senses.definitionCN: 社会内部代代相传的信仰或习俗
senses.example: It is a tradition to gather for dinner on New Year's Eve.
senses.exampleCN: 除夕聚在一起吃年夜饭是这里的传统。
senses.why: The core image is handing something old from older hands to younger ones.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是把古老的东西从长辈手中交到晚辈手中。

senses.title: An established practice or way of doing things
senses.definition: an established way of behaving or doing something in a group
senses.definitionCN: 群体中约定俗成的行事方式
senses.example: By tradition, the oldest member opens the ceremony.
senses.exampleCN: 按照惯例，由最年长的成员宣布典礼开始。
senses.why: A custom repeated many times hardens into a rule-like practice.
senses.whyCN: 习俗被反复执行，便硬化为近乎规则的惯例。

senses.title: A story or body of knowledge handed down orally
senses.definition: a story or set of teachings transmitted by word of mouth rather than writing
senses.definitionCN: 靠口耳相传而非文字记录的故事或学说
senses.example: The tribe keeps its history alive through oral tradition.
senses.exampleCN: 这个部族靠口述传统保存自己的历史。
senses.why: What cannot be written down must survive by being told and retold.
senses.whyCN: 无法落笔成文的东西，只能靠一次次讲述存续。

intro.en: Tradition comes from Latin traditio, a handing over or delivering, from tradere, to hand over or transmit, itself from trans- and dare, to give.
intro.cn: tradition 来自拉丁语 traditio（交付、传递），动词 tradere 意为「移交、传下」，由 trans-（跨越）与 dare（给予）构成。

items.en: tradere meant to hand over or transmit, built on trans- (across) + dare (to give).
items.cn: 拉丁语 tradere 意为「移交、传下」，由 trans-（跨越）加 dare（给予）构成。

items.en: traditio named the act of handing down teachings or teachings themselves.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 traditio 指传授行为或所传授的学说。

items.en: The word passed through Old French as tradicion.
items.cn: 该词经古法语 tradicion 进入法语。

items.en: Borrowed into English with religious and legal senses of handing over.
items.cn: 进入英语时兼有宗教与法律上的「移交」含义。

items.en: The sense settled on inherited customs, practices, and oral teachings.
items.cn: 词义最终固定为继承而来的习俗、惯例与口传学说。

note.en: Words that look or sound close to tradition, and words in the heritage field.
note.cn: 与 tradition 形近音近的词，以及同属传承义场的词。

entries.definitionCN: 传统的（较旧的形容词形式），traditional 的旧写法
叛国者，与 tradition 拼写相近但词义相反：一个是传下去，一个是背弃

entries.definition: a particular version of a published text
entries.definitionCN: 版本，与 tradition 同以 -dition 结尾，词源不同

entries.definition: an accepted way of behaving in a society
entries.definitionCN: 习俗；风俗，强调社会习惯，tradition 强调世代相传

entries.definition: valued things inherited from the past
entries.definitionCN: 遗产；继承物，涵盖建筑、文化等更广

entries.definition: an accepted way of behaving or a formal agreement
entries.definitionCN: 惯例；公约，强调约定俗成

entries.definition: the plural custom meaning habits of a group
entries.definitionCN: （复数）风俗习惯，与 tradition 在民俗语境近义

normalIntro.en: See tradition as hands passing an old lamp down a line of people.
normalIntro.cn: 把 tradition 想成人们排成一列，把一盏旧灯手手相传。

normal.en: trade + ition: what is handed along the line
normal.cn: 可联想 trade（交手）+ 词尾：沿着队伍传递的东西

normal.en: Latin dare (to give) inside the word
normal.cn: 词中藏着拉丁语 dare（给）：传统就是「传给」
常用搭配 break with tradition（打破传统）

normal.en: oral tradition = stories passed by word of mouth
normal.cn: oral tradition＝口述传统，靠讲述存续
词尾 -tion 表示动作名词：交出去的过程

abstract.en: An old lamp passed hand to hand down a dark line of generations
abstract.cn: 一盏旧灯在黑暗的世代长队中被手手传递

abstract.en: Breaking tradition feels like dropping that lamp
abstract.cn: 打破传统就像失手摔了那盏灯

abstract.en: Hear the word whisper: it was handed to you
abstract.cn: 听这个词的低语：它是被「交给」你的

examples.en: Keeping the spring festival tradition helps the family stay close.
examples.cn: 延续春节的传统让一家人保持亲密。

examples.en: The university has a long tradition of academic freedom.
examples.cn: 这所大学有悠久的学术自由传统。

examples.en: According to oral tradition, the village was founded by sailors.
examples.cn: 据口述传统，这座村庄由水手建立。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「踹地的」——爷爷踹着地面说：地上的老规矩不能丢！踹（trad）地（ition）→ tradition 就是踩着前人脚印走的传统。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（跨越）+ dare（给予）→ tradere「传过去」→ traditio「传承之物」；核心永远是「给出去、传下去」。

sensesIntro.en: From handing over teachings, the word grew into inherited customs, firm conventions, and oral lore.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「传授」这一动作长出世代习俗、固定惯例与口传学说诸义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: hands passing an old lamp down a line of generations
core.cn: 核心意象：一盏旧灯在世代之间手手相传

branches.en: customs inherited from elders
branches.cn: 从长辈继承的习俗

branches.en: practices so regular they feel like rules
branches.cn: 规律到近乎规则的沿袭做法

branches.en: stories kept alive by retelling
branches.cn: 靠复述存续的传说

branches.en: what the voice passes on becomes what the group lives by
branches.cn: 口中所传，即是群体所依

branches.en: unwritten knowledge also gets handed over
branches.cn: 没有文字的知识同样被传递

intro.en: Tradition is built on Latin trans- + dare; the same root gives a family of handing-over words.
intro.cn: tradition 建立在拉丁语 trans- 加 dare 之上，同根词都含「传递」之意。

latinIntro.en: Latin tradere also gave English traitor, betray, and treaty through related forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tradere 还通过相关形式派生了英语的 traitor、betray 和 treaty。

items.meaning: one who hands over to the enemy
items.meaningCN: 叛国者；背叛者（同根反义）

items.meaning: to hand over to an enemy; break faith

latinEntries.meaning: one who hands over; a betrayer

definition_zh: 传统的；惯例的；因袭的；习俗的
definition_en: following customs or beliefs handed down from the past
core_image: 老裁缝踩缝纫机：按老样子做衣服
scene: 端午临近，外婆在厨房里包粽子，手法和年轻时一模一样：At the wedding the bride wore a bright red dress in the local traditional style.
sceneCN: 这里 traditional 是「传统的」（第 1 个义项：沿袭旧俗的）；句意是新娘按当地老习俗穿红嫁衣。

derivatives.zh: 由 traditional 加 -ly 构成，义为「传统上；通常」
由 traditional 加 -ism 构成，义为「传统主义；因袭守旧」
由 traditional 加 -ist 构成，义为「传统主义者；守旧者」

senses.title: Following customs handed down from the past
senses.definition: following beliefs or ways of behaving that have existed for a long time
senses.definitionCN: 遵循久已存在的信仰或行为方式
senses.example: The family eats a traditional meal on the last night of the year.
senses.exampleCN: 这家人在年末最后一晚吃传统大餐。
senses.why: The core image is making things the old way, the way the lamp was always lit.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是按老办法行事——就像灯一直被那样点亮。

senses.title: Existing as a long-established custom
senses.definition: existing as part of an established practice rather than a new decision
senses.definitionCN: 作为既定惯例存在，而非新近决定
senses.example: Traditionally, the manager signs the report first.
senses.exampleCN: 按惯例，经理第一个在报告上签字。
senses.why: A custom repeated so often becomes the default way.
senses.whyCN: 习俗重复太多次，便成了默认做法。

senses.title: Unwilling to accept new ways
senses.definition: preferring old ways and resisting change
senses.definitionCN: 偏好旧方式并抗拒改变
senses.example: The school is quite traditional and still uses textbooks only.
senses.exampleCN: 这所学校相当守旧，仍然只用纸质教材。
senses.why: Holding the lamp too tightly means refusing any new flame.
senses.whyCN: 把旧灯攥得太紧，就意味着拒绝任何新火。

intro.en: Traditional is the adjective of tradition, built with the Latin-derived suffix -al on traditio, a handing down.
intro.cn: traditional 是 tradition 的形容词形式，在拉丁语来源 traditio（传承）上加形容词后缀 -al 构成。

items.en: traditio meant a handing over or the teachings handed down.
items.cn: 拉丁语 traditio 意为「传承之物」或传承行为。

items.en: traditionalis described things relating to what is handed down.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 traditionalis 描述与传承相关的事物。

items.en: English took both tradition and its adjective from French and Latin.
items.cn: 英语的 tradition 与其形容词均借自法语和拉丁语。

items.en: The adjective settled on customs, dress, medicine, and values.
items.cn: 形容词逐渐用于习俗、服装、医学与价值观。

items.en: The extended sense of resisting change is common in modern usage.
items.cn: 现代用法中「守旧」的引申义十分常见。

note.en: Words that look or sound close to traditional, and words in the established-ways field.
note.cn: 与 traditional 形近音近的词，以及同属既定方式义场的词。

normalIntro.en: Link the long word to tradition and the -al ending.
normalIntro.cn: 把长词拆成 tradition 加 -al 来记。

normal.cn: tradition 加 -al 即其形容词形式
高频搭配：传统文化、传统医学

normal.en: traditionally = most of the time, by custom
normal.cn: traditionally＝传统上、通常

normal.en: -al turns a noun into an adjective
normal.cn: -al 把名词变成形容词：nation→national 同理
traditionalist＝守着老办法的人

abstract.en: The old tailor sewing by the same pattern as his grandfather
abstract.cn: 老裁缝照着祖父的版型缝衣

abstract.en: A lamp lit the same way for a hundred years
abstract.cn: 一盏灯用同一方式点亮了一百年

abstract.en: New wind shakes the window; the room keeps its old light
abstract.cn: 新风吹动窗户，屋里仍留着旧光

examples.en: They prefer traditional Chinese medicine to pills.
examples.cn: 比起药片，他们更信任传统中药。

examples.en: Traditionally, children give their elders a New Year greeting.
examples.cn: 按传统，孩子们要向长辈拜年。

examples.en: His views are a bit too traditional for young readers.
examples.cn: 对年轻读者来说，他的观点有些过于守旧。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「传滴信了」——传统的东西一代传一代，像水滴一样信得过：传滴信了→ traditional。词根就是 tradition。

root: 拉丁语 trans- + dare（给）→ traditio「传承之物」+ -al「与……相关的」：与传统之事相关的。

sensesIntro.en: From following inherited customs, the adjective widens to firm conventions and resistance to change.
sensesIntro.cn: 形容词从沿袭旧俗扩展到固定惯例与抗拒变化。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the old tailor sewing by grandfather's pattern
core.cn: 核心意象：老裁缝照祖父的版型缝衣

branches.en: ways of doing things inherited from the past
branches.cn: 从过去继承的行事方式

branches.en: the default way when no decision is made
branches.cn: 未做决定时的默认做法

branches.en: refusal of the new in favour of the old
branches.cn: 宁旧勿新的态度

branches.en: custom repeated so long it feels natural
branches.cn: 重复太久以致浑然天成的习俗

branches.en: the default can harden into stubbornness
branches.cn: 默认做法会硬化为固执

intro.en: Traditional keeps the Latin skeleton of tradition and adds the adjective suffix -al.
intro.cn: traditional 保留 tradition 的拉丁骨架，另加形容词后缀 -al。

latinIntro.en: The -al suffix is from Latin -alis, used to make adjectives from nouns.
latinIntro.cn: 后缀 -al 来自拉丁语 -alis，用于由名词构成形容词。

latinEntries.meaning: relating to what is handed down
relating to; of the kind of

definition_zh: 交通；车流；流量；非法交易；运输量
definition_en: the movement of vehicles and people, or the illegal buying and selling of goods
core_image: 十字路口流动的河：车灯汇成光的河床
scene: 晚高峰的路口，司机们盯着前方望不见头的车龙叹气：晚高峰时警察站在路口，挥着手疏导那条川流不息、一眼望不到头的 traffic。
sceneCN: 这里 traffic 是「交通；车流」（第 1 个义项：道路上的车流）；句意是警察在路口指挥繁忙车流。

derivatives.zh: 由动词 traffic 加现在分词构成，义为「非法贩运」
由动词 traffic 加 -er 构成，义为「贩子；非法交易者」

senses.title: The movement of vehicles and pedestrians on roads
senses.definition: the vehicles and people moving along roads at a given time
senses.definitionCN: 某一时刻道路上移动的车辆和行人
senses.example: The traffic was so heavy that we walked instead.
senses.exampleCN: 路上太堵，我们干脆步行。
senses.why: The core image is a flowing river of vehicles; when the river stops, it is a jam.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是车辆汇成的河；河一停就是堵塞。

senses.title: The amount or volume of movement or exchange
senses.definition: the number of aircraft, ships, or messages moving through a system
senses.definitionCN: 通过某一系统的飞机、船只或信息数量
senses.example: Air traffic over the city has doubled in ten years.
senses.exampleCN: 十年间该城市上空的航空流量翻倍。
senses.why: Rivers of cars become rivers of planes and data, all measured as flow.
senses.whyCN: 车流变成机流与数据流，都被当作流量衡量。

senses.title: Illegal buying and selling of goods or people
senses.definition: the illegal trade in drugs, weapons, or human beings
senses.definitionCN: 毒品、武器或人口的非法买卖
senses.example: The police broke up a network trafficking in stolen art.
senses.exampleCN: 警方破获了一个贩运被盗艺术品的网络。
senses.why: A road that carries legal goods can also carry forbidden ones: the flow itself is neutral.
senses.whyCN: 运送合法货物的路也能运送违禁品：流动本身是中性的。

intro.en: Traffic is generally assumed to come from Old Italian traffico or its verb trafficare, of uncertain further origin, entering English through trade vocabulary in the age of Mediterranean commerce.
intro.cn: traffic 一般认为源自古意大利语 traffico 或动词 trafficare，更早词源不确定，于地中海商业时代经贸易词汇进入英语。

items.en: traffico and trafficare named the carrying on of trade.
items.cn: 一般认为古意大利语 traffico 与 trafficare 指「从事买卖」。

items.en: Passed through French trafique in trade writing.
items.cn: 经法语 trafique 进入商业文献。

items.en: Recorded as trade, especially overseas commerce.
items.cn: 16 世纪记作贸易，尤指海外商业。

items.en: The sense narrowed to the movement of vehicles and goods on roads.
items.cn: 词义收窄为道路上的车辆与货物运输。

items.en: Added the senses of data flow and illegal trade.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了数据流量与非法交易的义项。

note.en: Words that look or sound close to traffic, and words in the movement-and-trade field.
note.cn: 与 traffic 形近音近的词，以及同属流动与交易义场的词。

entries.definitionCN: 贩子；非法交易者，traffic 的派生名词

entries.definition: French spelling of the same word
entries.definitionCN: 法语拼法 trafic，与英语只差一个字母
经典作品，与 traffic 词尾相近，词源无关

entries.definition: blocking caused by too much traffic
entries.definitionCN: 拥堵；阻塞，traffic 过量的结果

entries.definition: systems for carrying people and goods
entries.definitionCN: 运输；交通系统，指整体体系
贸易，traffic 的最早词义即买卖
流动；流量，traffic 的核心意象

normalIntro.en: See the traffic lights standing over a river of cars.
normalIntro.cn: 想象信号灯立 在一条车流之河上。

normal.en: traffic jam = cars stuck like log jam
normal.cn: traffic jam＝车辆像木头一样堵住河道
高频搭配：红绿灯、繁忙交通

normal.en: air traffic = planes in the sky
normal.cn: air traffic＝空中的飞机流
trafficking＝非法的「流动」（贩运）

normal.en: web traffic = visitors to a website
normal.cn: web traffic＝网站访问流量，同一意象搬到网上

abstract.en: A river of headlights flowing between dark buildings
abstract.cn: 车灯之河在楼宇间流淌

abstract.en: Red light: the river freezes; green: it flows again
abstract.cn: 红灯河冻结，绿灯河复流

abstract.en: Goods flowing on the same road, some legal, some not
abstract.cn: 同一条路上流过合法与不法的货物

examples.en: The new bridge relieved traffic in the old town.
examples.cn: 新大桥缓解了老城区的交通。

examples.en: She was late because of a traffic jam on the ring road.
examples.cn: 她因环路上的堵车而迟到。

examples.en: He was arrested for trafficking in protected animals.
examples.cn: 他因贩运受保护动物被捕。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「踹费客」——路口车太多，司机踹了油门还得多交过路费，客人全都堵在后面：踹费客→traffic。

root: 一般认为源自古意大利语 traffico/trafficare（做买卖），更早词源不确定；早期义为「贸易」，后转为「运输流动」，再引申出数据流量与非法贩运。

sensesIntro.en: From trade on the move, the word narrowed to road flow, widened to all flows, and darkened into illegal trade.
sensesIntro.cn: 从流动中的买卖收窄为道路车流，扩展为一切流量，又变暗为非法交易。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a river of headlights flowing through the crossroads
core.cn: 核心意象：车灯之河流过十字路口

branches.en: vehicles and people moving on roads
branches.cn: 道路上行进的车辆与行人

branches.en: the measured volume of any flow
branches.cn: 被计量的任何流动量

branches.en: trade that the law forbids
branches.cn: 法律禁止的买卖

branches.en: when flow exceeds the channel, congestion follows
branches.cn: 流量超出河道便是拥堵

branches.en: the same neutral flow can carry forbidden goods
branches.cn: 同样的中性流动也可能运送违禁品

intro.en: Traffic has no classical affixes; its family is Italian and French trade vocabulary.
intro.cn: traffic 不含古典词缀，词族属于意大利语与法语的商业词汇。

latinIntro.en: Traffic has no Latin root; its source is Old Italian traffico, further origin uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: traffic 没有拉丁词根，源自古意大利语 traffico，更早来源不确定。

items.meaning: flow of vehicles or illegal trade
regular travel between home and work

definition_zh: 预告片；拖车；挂车；活动房屋
definition_en: a short film preview, or a vehicle pulled behind another vehicle
core_image: 被大车拖着跑的小车厢：一段被拖在正片前面的短片
scene: 公路服务区外，一辆挂车缓缓停稳，司机下车查看货物：电影开场前，银幕上突然响起轰鸣声，一段精彩的短片让全场安静下来看完了 trailer。
sceneCN: 这里 trailer 是「预告片」（第 1 个义项：电影前导短片）；句意是正片前的预告片吸引全场。

pos.zh: 预告片；拖车；挂车；活动房屋

derivatives.zh: 口语俚语：住在活动房屋里的人，由 trailer 加 -ite 构成（非正式用法）
与 trailer 相关的动作词「拖、牵引」，非派生但常用搭配词

senses.title: A short preview shown before a film
senses.definition: a short film of scenes from an upcoming movie, shown to advertise it
senses.definitionCN: 为宣传新片而剪辑的即将上映电影的短片
senses.example: The trailer for the new space film made everyone cheer.
senses.exampleCN: 这部新太空电影的预告片让全场欢呼。
senses.why: The trailer is dragged out in front of the main film, just like the cart in front.
senses.whyCN: 预告片被「拖」到正片前放映，正如拖车跟在车后——被拖者先露面。

senses.title: A vehicle pulled behind a car or lorry
senses.definition: a wheeled vehicle drawn by another vehicle, used to carry loads or people
senses.definitionCN: 由其他车辆牵引的带轮车辆，用于载货或载人
senses.example: They packed the boat onto the trailer behind the car.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把小艇装上车后的拖车。
senses.why: The core image is something carried by being pulled along.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是被拖着走、驮在身后的东西。

senses.title: A mobile home in a park or site
senses.definition: a caravan or mobile home that can be towed and lived in
senses.definitionCN: 可牵引居住的房车或移动住宅
senses.example: The family spent the summer in a trailer by the lake.
senses.exampleCN: 这家人夏天住在湖边的活动房屋里。
senses.why: A home on wheels is still a thing pulled behind a car.
senses.whyCN: 装上轮子的家，本质上仍是车后拖着的东西。

intro.en: Trailer is the agent noun of trail, to pull behind, from Old French trailler, to follow or track, of Germanic origin. It first named a thing drawn behind, then the film dragged out before the main show.
intro.cn: trailer 是动词 trail 的施动名词，trail 来自古法语 trailler（跟随、追踪），一般认为源自日耳曼语。最初指被拖拽之物，后指被「拖」到正片之前的短片。

items.en: A Germanic root for dragging gave Old French trailler, to follow or tow.
items.cn: 一般认为日耳曼语「拖曳」词根经古法语 trailler 表示「跟随、牵引」。

items.en: The verb trail meant to drag behind or follow a track.
items.cn: 中古英语动词 trail 意为「拖在后面；循迹而行」。

items.en: Trailer named whatever was towed: a cart, a boat cradle, a net.
items.cn: trailer 指一切被拖之物：拖车、船架、渔网。

items.en: Film studios used the word for the preview dragged out before the feature.
items.cn: 20 世纪电影界用该词指被拖放到正片前的预告短片。

items.en: Added the American sense of a towable mobile home.
items.cn: 又增加美式「拖车式活动房屋」的含义。

note.en: Words that look or sound close to trailer, and words in the film-preview field.
note.cn: 与 trailer 形近音近的词，以及同属影片宣传义场的词。

entries.definition: a path or to follow behind
entries.definitionCN: 小径；追踪，trailer 的动词根
裁缝，与 trailer 发音几乎相同但词源不同
栏杆；铁轨，藏在 trailer 的拼写里但词源无关
先导预告；悬念短片，预告片的一种

entries.definition: a lorry with a detachable trailer
entries.definitionCN: 拖挂卡车，trailer 的典型应用
（英）房车；大篷车，与美式 trailer 同义
预映；预览，更笼统的说法

normalIntro.en: Remember that the preview is dragged out before the film.
normalIntro.cn: 记住预告片是被「拖」到正片前面的。

normal.en: trailer = trail + er: the thing that trails behind
normal.cn: trailer＝trail（拖）+ er：跟在后面的东西

normal.en: film trailer plays before the film
normal.cn: 电影预告片在正片之前播放——被拖者先露面
trailer park＝活动房屋社区，轮子上的家

normal.en: tailor vs trailer: the tailor sews, the trailer trails
normal.cn: tailor（裁缝）缝衣，trailer 拖拽，发音相近勿混
teaser trailer（先导预告）比正式预告更早发布

abstract.en: A little wagon rolling behind the big truck down the highway
abstract.cn: 公路上小拖车跟在大卡车后面滚动

abstract.en: A burst of exciting scenes flashing before the main film begins
abstract.cn: 正片开始前闪过一串精彩片段

abstract.en: A house riding quietly on four wheels beside the lake
abstract.cn: 一座房子安安静静踩着四个轮子停在湖边

examples.en: We watched the trailer and decided to book two tickets.
examples.cn: 我们看了预告片，决定订两张票。

examples.en: The lorry pulled a long trailer full of furniture.
examples.cn: 卡车拖着一节装满家具的长挂车。

examples.en: They live in a trailer near the coast all winter.
examples.cn: 他们整个冬天住在海边的一辆活动房屋里。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吹了儿」——预告片把最精彩的部分全「吹」了出来：先吹后看。拖车跟在车后，预告片排在片前，都叫 trailer。

root: trail（拖、循迹）的施动名词 + -er：被拖之物。trail 一般认为经古法语 trailler 源自日耳曼语「拖曳」词根。

sensesIntro.en: From the cart towed behind, the word leapt to the film dragged before the show and the home on wheels.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被拖的车厢跳到被「拖」到片头的短片，再变成轮子上的家。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something carried by being pulled along
core.cn: 核心意象：被拖着走、驮在身后的东西

branches.en: the preview dragged before the feature
branches.cn: 被拖到正片前的预告

branches.en: the wheeled vehicle towed by a car or lorry
branches.cn: 被汽车或卡车牵引的挂车

branches.en: a home that can be towed away
branches.cn: 可以被拖走的家

branches.en: both appear because something stronger pulls them
branches.cn: 两者都因更强者的牵引而存在

branches.en: from two minutes of film to a whole life on wheels
branches.cn: 从两分钟短片到整轮子上的生活

intro.en: Trailer keeps the native -er agent suffix on the verb trail.
intro.cn: trailer 在动词 trail 上保留本土施动后缀 -er。

latinIntro.en: Trailer has no Latin relatives; it descends from a Germanic root through Old French.
latinIntro.cn: trailer 没有拉丁同族词，一般认为经古法语源自日耳曼语根。

items.meaning: to drag behind or follow a track
to pull by rope or chain
the people trailing behind a VIP

definition_zh: 火车；列车；一系列；训练；培养；培训
definition_en: a line of connected railway carriages, or to teach skills through practice
core_image: 首尾相连的一串车厢，也像一节节连起来的练习日
scene: 站台广播响起，旅客们提起行李，排队等候上车：清晨站台广播响起，等了一夜的人们拖着行李，终于登上了开往北京的 train。
sceneCN: 这里 train 是「火车」（第 1 个义项：铁路列车）；句意是人们清晨登上开往北京的列车。

derivatives.zh: 由动词 train 加现在分词构成，义为「训练；培训」
由动词 train 加 -er 构成，义为「教练；训练师」
由动词 train 加 -ee 构成，义为「受训者；学员」

senses.title: A line of connected railway carriages
senses.definition: connected carriages or wagons pulled along a railway
senses.definitionCN: 由机车牵引、在铁路上行驶的连挂车厢
senses.example: The train to Beijing leaves at seven in the morning.
senses.exampleCN: 开往北京的火车早上七点发车。
senses.why: The core image is a line of things linked one behind another.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是一串首尾相连的东西。

senses.title: A sequence or series of connected things
senses.definition: a set of events, thoughts, or things following one after another
senses.definitionCN: 接连发生或相继出现的一系列事件、想法或事物
senses.example: She lost her train of thought when the phone rang.
senses.exampleCN: 电话一响，她的思路就断了。
senses.why: Any linked line of things shares the image of connected carriages.
senses.whyCN: 任何相连成串之物都共享「连挂车厢」的意象。

senses.title: To teach skills through practice
senses.definition: to teach a person or animal the skills for a task by practice
senses.definitionCN: 通过练习使人或动物掌握某项技能
senses.example: Athletes train six hours a day for the Olympics.
senses.exampleCN: 运动员每天训练六小时备战奥运会。
senses.why: Practice sessions line up one after another like linked carriages.
senses.whyCN: 一次次的练习像连挂的车厢一样排成长队。

senses.title: To make a plant grow in a shaped way
senses.definition: to make a plant grow along a frame or in a chosen shape
senses.definitionCN: 使植物沿支架或按特定形状生长
senses.example: They trained the vines over the garden gate.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把藤蔓牵引到园门上方。
senses.why: Guiding growth step by step is training in slow motion.
senses.whyCN: 一步步引导生长，就是慢镜头下的训练。

senses.title: To aim a weapon or camera
senses.definition: to point a gun, light, or camera at a target
senses.definitionCN: 把枪、灯光或镜头对准目标
senses.example: The cameras were trained on the stage door.
senses.exampleCN: 摄像机全部对准舞台侧门。
senses.why: Following a target steadily is like following a track steadily.
senses.whyCN: 稳定跟随目标，正如沿着轨迹持续追随。

intro.en: Train comes from Old French train, a pulling or trailing, related to trahiner and Latin trahere, to draw or pull. A train was first the trailing part of a gown or a procession, then linked vehicles, then the series and the drill.
intro.cn: train 来自古法语 train（拉、拖），与 trahiner 相关，一般认为可追溯至拉丁语 trahere（拉、曳）。train 最早指礼服拖尾或行进的队伍，后指连挂车辆，再引申为序列与训练。

items.en: trahere meant to draw or pull, root of trace and track words.
items.cn: 拉丁语 trahere 意为「拉、曳」，是 trace、track 等词的词根。

items.en: train and trahiner meant to pull or trail along.
items.cn: 古法语 train 与 trahiner 意为「拉、拖曳」。

items.en: Train meant a trailing part, a retinue, or a procession.
items.cn: 中古英语 train 指拖尾、随从队伍或行列。

items.en: Linked wagons on rails were called a train of carriages.
items.cn: 铁轨上连挂的车厢被称为 a train of carriages。

items.en: The sense of systematic instruction grew from drawing minds along a line.
items.cn: 「系统训练」义由「沿一条线牵引心智」引申而来。

note.en: Words that look or sound close to train, and words in the series-and-instruction field.
note.cn: 与 train 形近音近的词，以及同属序列与教学义场的词。

entries.definition: one who trains others or oneself
entries.definitionCN: 教练；训练师，train 的派生名词
学员；受训者，train 的 -ee 派生

entries.definition: to injure by stretching, or pressure
entries.definitionCN: 拉伤；压力，与 train 只是首字母不同，词源不同
指导；辅导，与 train 的教学义近
操练；反复练习，强调机械重复
序列；连续，与 train 的「一系列」义近

entries.definition: the engine that pulls a train
entries.definitionCN: 机车；火车头，列车的一部分

normalIntro.en: Link the long snake of carriages to the long line of practice days.
normalIntro.cn: 把长长的车厢串和一节节的练习日连起来记。

normal.en: a train = carriages linked one behind another
normal.cn: 火车＝车厢首尾相连，所以 train 也指「一系列」

normal.en: train of thought: thoughts linked like carriages
normal.cn: train of thought＝像车厢一样连着的思路
trainer（教练）训练 trainee（学员）

normal.en: collocation: catch a train, train hard
normal.cn: 常用搭配：赶火车、刻苦训练

normal.en: Latin trahere = to pull, same root as trace
normal.cn: 拉丁词根 trahere（拉），与 trace 同根

abstract.en: A green engine pulling twelve carriages out of the fog
abstract.cn: 绿色机车从雾中拖出十二节车厢

abstract.en: Each practice day hooks onto the last like a carriage
abstract.cn: 每个训练日都像车厢一样挂在前一天之后

abstract.en: A camera lens slowly turning to face the stage door
abstract.cn: 镜头缓缓转向舞台侧门

examples.en: The high-speed train covers the distance in four hours.
examples.cn: 高铁四个小时就能跑完全程。

examples.en: They train rescue dogs to find people under snow.
examples.cn: 他们训练搜救犬在雪下找人。

examples.en: The journalists trained their cameras on the arrival gate.
examples.cn: 记者们把镜头对准到达口。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「锤恩」——火车轮撞击铁轨的声音：咣、咣、锤恩锤恩。一节节车厢连起来就叫 train，训练也是一节节练起来。

root: 古法语 train「拉、拖」，一般认为源自拉丁语 trahere「拉曳」：拖尾 → 行列 → 连挂车辆 → 沿一条线牵引（人、植物、镜头）。

sensesIntro.en: From a pulled line of cloth or carriages, the word extends to sequences, teaching, and aiming.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被拉曳的一串布幅或车厢，延伸到序列、教学与瞄准。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a line of things linked one behind another
core.cn: 核心意象：首尾相连的一串东西

branches.en: the railway vehicles linked together
branches.cn: 连挂在一起的铁路车辆

branches.en: thoughts or events hooked in a row
branches.cn: 连成一排的想法或事件

branches.en: lessons linked day after day
branches.cn: 一天接一天的课程

branches.en: guiding growth along a chosen line
branches.cn: 沿选定方向引导生长

branches.en: each practice session is another carriage in the train
branches.cn: 每节练习都是列车上的又一节车厢

intro.en: Train has no classical affixes, but the Latin root trahere feeds a family of pulling words.
intro.cn: train 本身不含古典词缀，但拉丁词根 trahere 派生出一族「拉曳」词。

latinIntro.en: Latin trahere also gave English extract, subtract, contract, and traction.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 trahere 还派生了英语的 extract、subtract、contract 与 traction。

definition_zh: 教练；训练师；训练器；运动鞋（英式口语）
definition_en: a person or device that trains others, or (British) a sports shoe
core_image: 站在场边掐秒表的人：把零散动作串成规定动作的人
scene: 体育馆里哨声一响，教练挥手让队员们开始折返跑：The whistle blew in the gym, and the coach waved the team to start shuttle runs under the trainer.
sceneCN: 这里 trainer 是「教练」（第 1 个义项：指导训练的人）；句意是教练哨响后带队折返跑。

pos.zh: 训练器；运动鞋（英式口语）

derivatives.zh: 由 trainee 加 -ship 构成，义为「培训期；见习岗位」
trainer 的动词根「训练；培训」，同源词
同根词「训练；培训」，由 train 加现在分词构成

senses.title: A person who coaches people or animals
senses.definition: a person who teaches skills or prepares people and animals for performance
senses.definitionCN: 教授技能或训练人、动物以达成绩效的人
senses.example: The trainer made the team run ten laps before lunch.
senses.exampleCN: 教练让全队午饭前跑了十圈。
senses.why: The core image is the one who keeps the line of practice moving.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是让那串「练习车厢」持续前进的人。

senses.title: A device used for practice
senses.definition: a machine or simulator used for practice or exercise
senses.definitionCN: 用于练习或锻炼的器械或模拟装置
senses.example: Pilots practise landings in a flight trainer.
senses.exampleCN: 飞行员在飞行训练器上练习着陆。
senses.why: The device stands in for the coach, guiding the same repeated drill.
senses.whyCN: 器械替代教练，引导同样的重复操练。

senses.title: A sports shoe (British informal)
senses.definition: a soft shoe worn for sport or casual wear in British English
senses.definitionCN: 英式英语中用于运动或休闲的软底鞋
senses.example: He bought new white trainers for the gym.
senses.exampleCN: 他为健身买了新的白色运动鞋。
senses.why: Shoes worn while training took the trainer's name.
senses.whyCN: 训练时穿的鞋，便借了 trainer 的名号。

intro.en: Trainer is the agent noun of train, built with the native -er suffix. The shoe sense arose in British English because such shoes were worn for training.
intro.cn: trainer 是动词 train 加本土施动后缀 -er 构成的施动名词。「运动鞋」义产生于英式英语，因这种鞋在训练时穿着而得名。

items.en: Latin trahere, to pull, underlies the family through Old French train.
items.cn: 拉丁语 trahere（拉）经古法语 train 支撑整个词族。

items.en: train meant to pull or trail along.
items.cn: 古法语 train 意为「拉、拖曳」。

items.en: Trainer first named one who draws up or educates; also one who treats disease by diet and exercise.
items.cn: 16 世纪 trainer 指「教育者」，也指以饮食运动治病的人。

items.en: The sports coach sense became dominant with modern athletics.
items.cn: 随着现代体育兴起，教练义占主导。

items.en: British informal use extended to sports shoes; American English prefers sneakers.
items.cn: 20 世纪英式口语把该词用于运动鞋，美式则说 sneakers。

note.en: Words that look or sound close to trainer, and words in the coaching field.
note.cn: 与 trainer 形近音近的词，以及同属教练义场的词。

entries.definitionCN: 受训者；学员，-er 施动、-ee 受动，方向相反
动词根是 train（训练），trainer 即「施训者」
裁缝，与 trainer 发音相近但词源完全不同

entries.definition: one who trains athletes or students
entries.definitionCN: 教练；辅导员，与 trainer 通用
指导者；教员，偏重课堂与技能教学
导师；良师，偏重长期指引
（美）运动鞋，对应英式 trainer

normalIntro.en: Keep trainer and trainee opposite: -er gives, -ee receives.
normalIntro.cn: 记住 trainer 与 trainee 方向相反：-er 给出训练，-ee 接受训练。

normal.en: train + er = the one who trains
normal.cn: train 加 -er＝施训者
trainer 施训，trainee 受训
personal trainer＝健身房里的私人教练
英式 trainers＝美式 sneakers（运动鞋）

normal.en: a flight trainer is a simulator
normal.cn: flight trainer＝飞行模拟训练器

abstract.en: A whistle, a stopwatch, and a coach pacing the sideline
abstract.cn: 哨声、秒表、在边线上踱步的教练

abstract.en: A cockpit box that shakes like a real plane
abstract.cn: 像真飞机一样晃动的模拟驾驶舱

abstract.en: Bright white shoes squeaking on the gym floor
abstract.cn: 亮白的球鞋在健身房地板上吱吱作响

examples.en: Her trainer designed a six-week plan for the race.
examples.cn: 她的教练为比赛设计了六周计划。

examples.en: The zoo hired a new animal trainer for the seal show.
examples.cn: 动物园为海豹表演聘了一位新驯兽师。

examples.en: My old trainers finally fell apart after two years.
examples.cn: 我的旧运动鞋穿了两年终于散架了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「揣呢儿」——教练总揣着秒表站在场边呢：揣呢儿→trainer。受训的是 trainee，施训的是 trainer。

root: train（源自拉丁 trahere「拉」）+ 施动后缀 -er：拉动整条训练线的人。与受动后缀 -ee 的 trainee 方向相对。

sensesIntro.en: From the person who pulls the practice line, to machines that do his job, and shoes worn doing it.
sensesIntro.cn: 从拉动练习线的人，到替他执行任务的器械，再到做这件事时穿的鞋。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the one who keeps the line of practice moving
core.cn: 核心意象：让练习之列持续前进的人

branches.en: the human coach guiding people or animals
branches.cn: 指导人或动物的教练

branches.en: machines that simulate practice
branches.cn: 代替人指导的练习器械

branches.en: shoes worn while training
branches.cn: 训练时穿的运动鞋

branches.en: both coach and machine aim at the same repeated drill
branches.cn: 教练与器械瞄准同一种重复操练

branches.en: the shoe borrowed the coach's name
branches.cn: 运动鞋借走了教练的名号

intro.en: Trainer adds the native agent suffix -er to train, opposite to the -ee of trainee.
intro.cn: trainer 在 train 上加本土施动后缀 -er，与 trainee 的 -ee 受动后缀方向相反。

latinIntro.en: The -er suffix is Germanic; only the deeper root trahere is Latin, via Old French.
latinIntro.cn: -er 后缀是日耳曼语来源；只有更深的词根 trahere 是拉丁语，经古法语传入。

items.meaning: a trainer of sports or study

latinEntries.meaning: one who arranges or builds in

definition_zh: 交易；办理；事务；会议记录
definition_en: an instance of business done, especially buying and selling or the handling of matters
core_image: 柜台上一张盖章的收据：一次办妥的交接
scene: 手机支付页面弹出提示，买家确认后订单随即生成：银行窗口的电子屏提示音一响，柜台职员微笑着敲下回车，完成了这笔 transaction。
sceneCN: 这里 transaction 是「交易」（第 1 个义项：一笔办妥的业务）；句意是银行职员完成了一笔交易。

derivatives.zh: 由 transaction 加 -al 构成，义为「交易性的；事务性的」
transaction 的动词根「办理；处理」，同源词
由动词 transact 加 -er 构成，义为「办理人；交易者」（较少用）

senses.title: An act of buying and selling or business done
senses.definition: a single act of doing business, such as a purchase or sale
senses.definitionCN: 一次商业行为，如购买或出售
senses.example: Each transaction is recorded in the bank's system.
senses.exampleCN: 每笔交易都会记录在银行系统中。
senses.why: The core image is a matter carried across the counter and finished.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是事情被送过柜台并办结。

senses.title: The handling or conducting of business matters
senses.definition: the management or carrying out of business or affairs
senses.definitionCN: 对商务或事务的管理与执行
senses.example: He is skilled in the transaction of difficult negotiations.
senses.exampleCN: 他擅长处理棘手的谈判事务。
senses.why: Carrying a matter across means seeing it through from side to side.
senses.whyCN: 把事情「送过去」意味着从头到尾办完。

senses.title: Published records of meetings or society papers
senses.definition: the published records of a learned society's meetings or papers
senses.definitionCN: 学术团体会议记录或论文的出版物
senses.example: The transactions of the society appear twice a year.
senses.exampleCN: 该学会的会刊每年出版两次。
senses.why: A completed act of business, once written down, becomes a record.
senses.whyCN: 办完的业务被写下来，便成为记录。

intro.en: Transaction comes from Latin transactio, a completion or agreement, from transigere, to drive through or finish, built on trans- (across) and agere (to drive, do).
intro.cn: transaction 来自拉丁语 transactio（完成、办结），动词 transigere 意为「穿过办妥」，由 trans-（跨越）与 agere（驱使、做）构成。

items.en: transigere meant to drive through, finish, or settle.
items.cn: 拉丁语 transigere 意为「贯穿完成、了结」。

items.en: transactio named the completion or settlement of a matter.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 transactio 指事务的完成或了结。

items.en: The word entered English through French in legal use.
items.cn: 该词经法语以法律用法进入英语。

items.en: Applied to conducting business and to society records.
items.cn: 17 世纪用于商务处理与学会记录。

items.en: Now dominated by commercial and financial dealings.
items.cn: 现代用法以商业与金融交易为主。

note.en: Words that look or sound close to transaction, and words in the deal field.
note.cn: 与 transaction 形近音近的词，以及同属交易义场的词。

entries.definition: a change from one state to another
entries.definitionCN: 过渡；转变，与 transaction 拼写相近但词尾不同：-act- 办事，-it- 走过去
办理；交易，transaction 的动词形式
输血，与 transaction 同有 trans- 前缀但词根不同
交易；协议，口语常用词
贸易；买卖，广义的交易活动

entries.definition: the act of carrying out business
entries.definitionCN: 运作；经营，强调执行过程
事务；事态，transaction 的第 2 义近词

normalIntro.en: Split the word: trans- (across) + act (do) + ion.
normalIntro.cn: 拆词记忆：trans-（跨过）+ act（做）+ ion（名词尾）。

normal.en: trans- + act + ion: a doing carried across
normal.cn: 跨过去做完的一件事＝交易
常用搭配 complete a transaction（完成交易）

normal.en: watch out for transition, not transaction
normal.cn: 小心别与 transition（过渡）混淆
动词形式是 transact（办理）

normal.en: transactions can also mean society records
normal.cn: transactions 也可指学会会刊

abstract.en: A stamp coming down on a receipt across the counter
abstract.cn: 一枚印章越过柜台盖在收据上

abstract.en: A matter pushed from one side of the desk to the other
abstract.cn: 一件事从桌子一端被推到另一端

abstract.en: Old journals binding each year's settled business
abstract.cn: 往年办结事务装订成册的会刊

examples.en: Payment failed, so the transaction had to be repeated.
examples.cn: 支付失败，这笔交易只好重来。

examples.en: The firm handles the transaction of all import paperwork.
examples.cn: 这家公司代办全部进口手续。

examples.en: The Royal Society publishes its transactions every quarter.
examples.cn: 皇家学会每季度出版一期会刊。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「踹爱在柜台」——踹了一脚爱就在柜台办完交易：trans（跨）+ action（行动），跨柜台的一步行动就是交易。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（跨越）+ agere（做、驱使）→ transigere「贯穿办妥」→ transactio「办结之事」：跨过柜台、一次办完。

sensesIntro.en: From a matter driven through to completion, the word covers deals, administration, and published records.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「贯穿办妥」这件事长出买卖、事务处理与出版物三义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a matter carried across the counter and finished
core.cn: 核心意象：事情被送过柜台并办结

branches.en: one completed act of buying or selling
branches.cn: 一次完成的买卖行为

branches.en: the managing of business matters
branches.cn: 商务事务的办理

branches.en: written records of settled business
branches.cn: 办结事务的书面记录

branches.en: to transact is to carry matters to their end
branches.cn: transact 即把事情办到底

branches.en: what is handled well gets written down
branches.cn: 办妥的事被记录成册

intro.en: Transaction is transparently Latin: trans- across, act from agere, -ion a noun ending.
intro.cn: transaction 的拉丁构词完全透明：trans-「跨过」，act 源自 agere，-ion 为名词后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin agere also gave act, action, agent, agile, and agitate.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 agere 还派生了 act、action、agent、agile 与 agitate。

definition_zh: 转移；转让；换乘；调动；传输；转会
definition_en: to move someone or something from one place, person, or situation to another
core_image: 一只手把杯子里的水倒进另一只杯子：水还是那杯水，位置换了
scene: 银行柜台前，职员核对完信息，提示客户确认汇款：地铁到站广播响起，人群涌出车厢，纷纷快步走向对面站台去换乘、完成自己的 transfer。
sceneCN: 这里 transfer 是动词「换乘」（第 3 个义项：从一地转到另一地）；句意是乘客下车换乘另一条地铁线。

derivatives.zh: 由 transfer 加 -able 构成，义为「可转移的；可转让的」
由 transfer 加 -ence 构成，义为「转移；（心理）移情」
由 transfer 加 -ee 构成，义为「受让人；被调动者」

senses.title: To move something or someone to another place
senses.definition: to take something or someone from one location to another
senses.definitionCN: 把某人某物从一个位置带到另一个位置
senses.example: They transferred the patient to a better hospital.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把病人转到了更好的医院。
senses.why: The core image is pouring water from one cup into another: same thing, new place.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是把水从一杯倒进另一杯：东西不变，位置变了。

senses.title: To hand over rights, money, or property
senses.definition: to legally give rights, money, or property to another person
senses.definitionCN: 依法把权利、钱款或财产交给他人
senses.example: She transferred the house to her daughter.
senses.exampleCN: 她把房子过户给了女儿。
senses.why: Ownership is a thing carried across hands like water.
senses.whyCN: 所有权像水一样被双手「倒」过去。

senses.title: To change from one vehicle or line to another
senses.definition: to change from one bus, train, or flight to another
senses.definitionCN: 换乘另一辆公交、列车或航班
senses.example: Passengers transfer to Line Two at this station.
senses.exampleCN: 乘客在这个站换乘二号线。
senses.why: The passenger himself is the thing carried across.
senses.whyCN: 此刻被「搬运」的正是乘客自己。

senses.title: To move to another job, school, or team
senses.definition: to move a person to another post, school, or club
senses.definitionCN: 把人调动到另一岗位、学校或俱乐部
senses.example: He was transferred to the Shanghai branch last year.
senses.exampleCN: 他去年被调到上海分部。
senses.why: A person's job is poured from one department into another.
senses.whyCN: 一个人的工作被从一个部门「倒」进另一个。

senses.title: To copy information or a disease to something else
senses.definition: to copy data, skills, or a condition onto another thing or person
senses.definitionCN: 把数据、技能或状态复制或传导到另一对象
senses.example: The virus can transfer from animals to humans.
senses.exampleCN: 病毒可以从动物传染给人。
senses.why: What flows across is no longer just things but information and conditions.
senses.whyCN: 跨越的不只是实物，还有信息与状态。

intro.en: Transfer comes from Latin transferre, to carry across, from trans- (across) and ferre (to carry, bear). The noun kept a stressed first syllable, the verb a stressed second.
intro.cn: transfer 来自拉丁语 transferre「搬运过去」，由 trans-（跨越）与 ferre（携带、承担）构成。名词重音在前，动词重音在后。

items.en: transferre meant to carry or bear across.
items.cn: 拉丁语 transferre 意为「搬运过去、带过去」。

items.en: ferre descends from a reconstructed root bher- meaning to carry.
items.cn: ferre 源于重构词根 bher-「携带」（重构形式）。

items.en: In Roman law, transferre covered handing over property.
items.cn: 罗马法中 transferre 用于财产的移转。

items.en: English borrowed the verb through legal and general use.
items.cn: 英语经法律与一般用法借入该动词。

items.en: Now covers money, data, jobs, vehicles, and even emotions.
items.cn: 现代用法涵盖钱款、数据、职务、换乘乃至情感移置。

note.en: Words that look or sound close to transfer, and words in the moving field.
note.cn: 与 transfer 形近音近的词，以及同属转移义场的词。

entries.definition: the act or process of transferring; a psychological term
entries.definitionCN: 转移；移情（心理学术语），transfer 的派生名词
改造；使变形，同前缀 trans- 不同词根：ferre 搬运，formare 造形
更喜欢，与 transfer 共享拉丁词根 ferre（携带）
移动；搬动，泛指位置变化
变换；移动，常用于方向与工作
运送；传达，偏正式
接转；传递，强调接力

normalIntro.en: Remember ferre, to carry: transfer always carries something across.
normalIntro.cn: 记住词根 ferre「携带」：transfer 永远是把什么「带过去」。

normal.cn: trans（跨）+ fer（携带）＝转移过去
高频搭配：转账、换乘站

normal.en: transfer vs transform: carry vs shape
normal.cn: transfer 搬运、transform 塑形，前缀相同词根不同
名词重音在前，动词重音在后
ferre 词族：prefer、refer、confer

abstract.en: Water poured from one glass into another
abstract.cn: 水从一只杯子倒进另一只杯子

abstract.en: A commuter stepping from one platform to another
abstract.cn: 通勤者从一个站台跨向另一个

abstract.en: A deed of ownership sliding across the desk
abstract.cn: 一纸产权证书滑过桌面

examples.en: Please transfer the money before Friday.
examples.cn: 请在周五前完成转账。

examples.en: She transferred to a high school in Hangzhou.
examples.cn: 她转学到了杭州的一所高中。

examples.en: The embassy arranged the transfer of the prisoner.
examples.cn: 大使馆安排了囚犯的移交。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「踹死佛」——搬家时连佛都踹着走：东西全踹（trans）死（fixed）佛（ferre 携带）→ transfer 什么都能搬走。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（跨越）+ ferre（携带）→ transferre「搬过去」：凡被带过界的，都是 transfer。ferre 同根词还有 prefer、refer、confer。

sensesIntro.en: From carrying things across, the word widened to rights, passengers, jobs, and invisible information.
sensesIntro.cn: 从搬运实物扩展到权利、乘客、职务与无形信息的转移。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: water poured from one cup into another
core.cn: 核心意象：水从一杯倒进另一杯

branches.en: things carried to a new location
branches.cn: 被搬到新位置的东西

branches.en: rights and money changing hands
branches.cn: 权利与钱款易主

branches.en: passengers changing vehicles or lines
branches.cn: 乘客换乘交通工具

branches.en: people moved to new posts or schools
branches.cn: 人被调往新岗位或学校

branches.en: even data and diseases travel by the same road
branches.cn: 数据与疾病也走同一条「搬运」之路

intro.en: Transfer is pure Latin: the prefix trans- on the irregular verb ferre.
intro.cn: transfer 是纯拉丁构词：不规则动词 ferre 加前缀 trans-。

latinIntro.en: Latin ferre also gave offer, refer, suffer, confer, and differ.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ferre 还派生了 offer、refer、suffer、confer 与 differ。

items.meaning: to carry back to a source

definition_zh: 使变形；使改观；转变；改造；变换
definition_en: to change the form, appearance, or nature of something completely
core_image: 毛虫变蝴蝶：还是同一个生命，模样彻底换了
scene: 旧厂房改造完工那天，居民们走进焕然一新的园区：On renovation day the designer opened the door and saw the empty shell changed into a bright library by the transform.
sceneCN: 这里 transform 是动词「使改观」（第 1 个义项：彻底改变外观或性质）；句意是旧厂房被改造成图书馆。

collocations.zh: 把 A 改造成 B

derivatives.zh: 由 transform 加 -ation 构成，义为「变形；改造；转变」
由 transform 加 -er 构成，义为「变压器；改造者」
由 transform 加 -ative 构成，义为「变革性的」

senses.title: To change the form or appearance completely
senses.definition: to change the shape or look of something entirely
senses.definitionCN: 使某物的形状或外观彻底改变
senses.example: The new paint transformed the old house.
senses.exampleCN: 新刷的漆让老房子焕然一新。
senses.why: The core image is a caterpillar becoming a butterfly: same being, new form.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是毛虫变蝴蝶：同一个生命，全新的形态。

senses.title: To change the nature or quality of something or someone
senses.definition: to change what something or someone is like in character
senses.definitionCN: 改变某物或某人的性质面貌
senses.example: Reading transformed her from a shy girl into a confident speaker.
senses.exampleCN: 阅读使她从羞涩的女孩变成自信的演讲者。
senses.why: Beyond the visible shape, the inner nature is remade.
senses.whyCN: 不止外形，内在性质也被重塑。

senses.title: To convert one form of energy or signal into another
senses.definition: to change energy or signals from one form to another
senses.definitionCN: 把能量或信号从一种形式变为另一种
senses.example: The station transforms steam power into electricity.
senses.exampleCN: 该站把蒸汽能转化为电能。
senses.why: What crosses over is form itself: energy enters one shape, leaves in another.
senses.whyCN: 跨越的正是形式本身：能量以一种形态进入，以另一种离开。

senses.title: To apply a mathematical transformation
senses.definition: to change variables or data according to a mathematical rule
senses.definitionCN: 按数学规则改变变量或数据
senses.example: The Fourier transform turns waves into frequencies.
senses.exampleCN: 傅里叶变换把波转换为频率。
senses.why: In mathematics the same object is simply re-expressed in another frame.
senses.whyCN: 数学中同一对象只是被换到另一坐标系重新表达。

intro.en: Transform comes from Latin transformare, to shape beyond or across, from trans- (across) and formare (to form), from forma, shape.
intro.cn: transform 来自拉丁语 transformare「越过原形重塑」，由 trans-（跨越）与 formare（塑形）构成，formare 出自 forma（形状）。

items.en: forma meant shape or figure, root of form.
items.cn: 拉丁语 forma 意为「形状」，是 form 的词根。

items.en: transformare meant to reshape or change the form of.
items.cn: 拉丁语 transformare 意为「重塑、改变形态」。

items.en: The word passed into French as transformer.
items.cn: 该词经法语 transformer 进入法语。

items.en: Borrowed into English with magical and physical senses.
items.cn: 进入英语时兼有魔法变身与物理改变之义。

items.en: Added senses in energy, signals, and mathematics.
items.cn: 现代英语增加能量、信号与数学的义项。

note.en: Words that look or sound close to transform, and words in the changing field.
note.cn: 与 transform 形近音近的词，以及同属改变义场的词。

entries.definition: a device that changes voltage; one who transforms
entries.definitionCN: 变压器；改造者，transform 的派生名词

entries.definition: the act or result of transforming
entries.definitionCN: 变形；改造，transform 的名词形式
转移，与 transform 同前缀不同词根：ferre 搬运，formare 塑形
改变，最泛用的说法

entries.definition: to change into another form or use
entries.definitionCN: 转换；改装，强调用途或形式的转換
改革；改良，同根 formare，强调变好
蜕变；变态（生物学），彻底的形态改变

normalIntro.en: Split it: trans- (across) + form (shape): the shape crosses over.
normalIntro.cn: 拆词记忆：trans-（跨越）+ form（形状）：形状翻越过去。

normal.en: trans + form = new shape across the line
normal.cn: 跨越旧形得到新形态
常用搭配 transform into（变成）

normal.en: transform vs transfer: shape vs carry
normal.cn: transform 变形、transfer 搬运
名词形式是 transformation（变化）
数学中的傅里叶变换

abstract.en: A caterpillar sealing itself into a chrysalis and breaking out as a butterfly
abstract.cn: 毛虫裹进蛹中，破蛹成蝶

abstract.en: A dim warehouse reborn as a glass library
abstract.cn: 昏暗仓库重生为明亮图书馆

abstract.en: Electricity entering one wire and leaving as light
abstract.cn: 电流进入一条线，出来时成了光

examples.en: Technology has transformed the way we shop.
examples.cn: 科技彻底改变了我们购物的方式。

examples.en: The garden was transformed into a small orchard.
examples.cn: 花园被改造成一个小果园。

examples.en: Her confidence transformed after one year of training.
examples.cn: 经过一年训练，她的自信心彻底改变。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「踹死缝」——裁缝把旧衣服踹进缝纫机，出来就是新造型：踹（trans）死（彻底）缝（form 塑形）→ transform。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（跨越）+ formare（塑形，出自 forma「形状」）→ transformare「越过原形重塑」：形态被整个翻新。

sensesIntro.en: From reshaping visible things, the word reaches into character, energy, and abstract mathematics.
sensesIntro.cn: 从重塑可见之物延伸到性格、能量与抽象数学。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a caterpillar becoming a butterfly
core.cn: 核心意象：毛虫变蝴蝶

branches.en: a complete change of appearance
branches.cn: 外观的彻底改变

branches.en: inner nature remade, not just the surface
branches.cn: 内在性质的重塑，不止表面

branches.en: energy or signals switching forms
branches.cn: 能量或信号的形态转换

branches.en: what looks new may truly be new inside
branches.cn: 外表的焕新可能伴随内在的更新

branches.en: mathematics reshapes the same object on paper
branches.cn: 数学在纸面上重塑同一对象

intro.en: Transform combines the prefix trans- with the formare family of Latin shape words.
intro.cn: transform 由前缀 trans- 与拉丁语 formare（塑形）词族组合而成。

latinIntro.en: Latin forma also gave formal, format, formula, and reform.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 forma 还派生了 formal、format、formula 与 reform。

items.meaning: to shape again for the better

latinEntries.meaning: to reshape, change the form of

definition_zh: 过渡；转变；转型；过渡期
definition_en: the process of changing from one state, form, or activity to another
core_image: 闸门之间的一小段桥：从这头走到那头
scene: 毕业典礼结束，学生收拾宿舍行李，准备走向职场：秋天来了，山里的小镇正悄悄地完成从夏日旅游到滑雪季的 transition。
sceneCN: 这里 transition 是「过渡」（第 1 个义项：从一种状态到另一种状态）；句意是小镇由夏季旅游过渡到滑雪季。

collocations.zh: 从 A 到 B 的过渡

derivatives.zh: 由 transition 加 -al 构成，义为「过渡的；临时的」
由 transition 加 -ist 构成，义为「主张转型者」（罕用）
由动词加现在分词构成，义为「转型过程；身份过渡」

senses.title: A change from one state or form to another
senses.definition: the act of changing from one state, stage, or form into another
senses.definitionCN: 从一种状态、阶段或形式变为另一种
senses.example: The transition from school to work is never easy.
senses.exampleCN: 从学校到职场的过渡从来不易。
senses.why: The core image is the short bridge between two gates: you are leaving one and arriving at the other.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是两道闸门之间的小桥：你既已离开一处，又正在抵达另一处。

senses.title: A period during which such change happens
senses.definition: a time during which a change of state is in progress
senses.definitionCN: 状态转变正在发生的时期
senses.example: The company set a two-year transition for the new system.
senses.exampleCN: 公司为新系统设置了两年过渡期。
senses.why: The bridge itself takes time to cross; that time is the transition.
senses.whyCN: 走完这座桥需要时间；这段时光就是过渡期。

senses.title: A smooth connection between pieces of writing or music
senses.definition: a passage connecting sections of text or music
senses.definitionCN: 连接文章或乐曲各部分的段落
senses.example: The essay needs a better transition between the two paragraphs.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇文章两段之间需要更好的衔接。
senses.why: Writers and composers build small bridges so their readers cross without stumbling.
senses.whyCN: 作者与作曲家搭起小桥，让读者顺畅走过。

intro.en: Transition comes from Latin transitio, a going across, from transire (to go across), built on trans- (across) and ire (to go).
intro.cn: transition 来自拉丁语 transitio「走过去」，动词 transire 由 trans-（跨越）与 ire（走）构成。

items.en: ire meant to go, a root also seen in exit and transit.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ire 意为「走」，也见于 exit、transit。

items.en: transire meant to go across or pass over.
items.cn: 拉丁语 transire 意为「跨过、经过」。

items.en: transitio named the passage between subjects in rhetoric.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 transitio 指修辞中的话题过渡。

items.en: Borrowed with meanings of passing and change.
items.cn: 16 世纪借入英语，意为经过与改变。

items.en: Now spans personal, political, and technical changes.
items.cn: 现代用法涵盖个人、政治与技术领域的转变。

note.en: Words that look or sound close to transition, and words in the change field.
note.cn: 与 transition 形近音近的词，以及同属转变义场的词。

entries.definitionCN: 交易，与 transition 只差词根：ire 走过去，agere 办妥
运输；通行，同根词 transire 的另一派生
短暂的；瞬间的，同源形容词
改变；变化，最通用的词

entries.definition: a change of form or use
entries.definitionCN: 转变；换算，强调形式的转换

entries.definition: a change of position or direction
entries.definitionCN: 变动；转移，偏方向与重心
彻底变形，强调结果的全新

normalIntro.en: Remember ire, to go: a transition is a change you walk across.
normalIntro.cn: 记住词根 ire「走」：transition 是要走过去的变化。

normal.cn: 跨过去（trans）+ 走（ition）＝过渡

normal.en: transit, transitory are the same family
normal.cn: transit（通行）、transitory（短暂）同属一词族
常用搭配 smooth transition（平稳过渡）
从 A 到 B 的过渡是固定句式
勿与 transaction（交易）混淆

abstract.en: A narrow bridge between two open gates
abstract.cn: 两道敞开的闸门之间的一座窄桥

abstract.en: A chrysalis hanging: neither caterpillar nor butterfly yet
abstract.cn: 悬在枝头的蛹：既非毛虫也非蝴蝶

abstract.en: A single chord sliding the song into a new key
abstract.cn: 一个和弦让歌曲滑进新调

examples.en: The country is going through a difficult economic transition.
examples.cn: 该国正经历艰难的经济转型。

examples.en: Good writing needs smooth transitions between paragraphs.
examples.cn: 好文章需要段落间顺畅的衔接。

examples.en: The bridge will close during the transition to a new route.
examples.cn: 路线切换期间大桥将封闭。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「踹日行」——过渡期里每天踹着自己往前走一脚：踹（trans）日（ire 走）行 → transition，走着过桥的意思。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（跨越）+ ire（走）→ transire「走过去」→ transitio「跨越之行走」：一切过渡都是走过去的那一段。

sensesIntro.en: From walking across, the word covers state changes, the time they take, and the joins in art.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「走过去」延伸到状态转变、转变所需的时间与艺术中的衔接。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the short bridge between two gates
core.cn: 核心意象：两道闸门之间的一座小桥

branches.en: the change itself between states
branches.cn: 状态之间的转变本身

branches.en: the time spent changing
branches.cn: 转变所占用的时间

branches.en: the written or musical join
branches.cn: 文章或乐曲的衔接

branches.en: you cannot rush the bridge; it has its own length
branches.cn: 桥有其长度，过渡不能硬赶

branches.en: both roads and texts need smooth crossings
branches.cn: 路与文章都需要顺畅的过渡

intro.en: Transition shows the Latin pair trans- + ire, shared by transit and transitory.
intro.cn: transition 呈现了拉丁语 trans- 加 ire 的组合，与 transit、transitory 同源。

latinIntro.en: Latin ire also gave exit, circuit, ambition (going around), and perish (going through).
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ire 还派生了 exit、circuit、ambition（四处奔走）与 perish（走完全程而消亡）。

items.meaning: the passing of goods or people

latinEntries.meaning: a going across, a passing over

definition_zh: 翻译；转译；转化；使转变；移动
definition_en: to change words or something else from one form or language into another
core_image: 把一桶水倒进另一个形状的容器：内容不变，容器换了语言
scene: 会议室内，同传耳机里的话音刚落，代表们纷纷点头：At the conference every delegate with headphones listened as the interpreter translated the speech live into their own language.
sceneCN: 这里 translate 是动词「翻译」（第 1 个义项：从一种语言转为另一种）；句意是译员同步翻译演讲。

derivatives.zh: 由 translate 加 -ion 构成，义为「翻译；译文」
由 translate 加 -or 构成，义为「翻译者；译员」
由 translate 加 -able 构成，义为「可翻译的；可转化的」

senses.title: To change speech or writing into another language
senses.definition: to express the meaning of one language in another
senses.definitionCN: 用另一种语言表达一种语言的意义
senses.example: The novel was translated into twelve languages.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说被译成十二种语言。
senses.why: The core image is carrying meaning across a border unchanged in spirit.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是把意义原封不动地「搬」过语言的边界。

senses.title: To change one form of expression into another
senses.definition: to turn something into a different form or way of saying it
senses.definitionCN: 把某物转成另一种形式或说法
senses.example: Please translate the code into plain language.
senses.exampleCN: 请把代码转述成平实的语言。
senses.why: Languages are not the only borders: jargon and symbols guard their own.
senses.whyCN: 语言的边界并非唯一：术语与符号也各有围墙。

senses.title: To convert into movement or another state
senses.definition: to bring about a change of state, movement, or result
senses.definitionCN: 引发状态、运动或结果的改变
senses.example: Pressure translated into determination on the court.
senses.exampleCN: 压力在赛场上转化成了决心。
senses.why: What crosses over this time is force or idea becoming effect.
senses.whyCN: 这次跨过边界的是力量或想法变成效果。

senses.title: To move from one position to another (physics)
senses.definition: to move an object so that every point shifts the same distance
senses.definitionCN: 使物体整体平行移动相同距离
senses.example: The figure is translated three units to the right.
senses.exampleCN: 该图形向右平移三个单位。
senses.why: Geometry borrows the Latin sense of carrying across space.
senses.whyCN: 几何学借用了拉丁语「在空间中搬运」的本义。

intro.en: Translate comes from Latin translatus, the irregular past of transferre, to carry across: trans- (across) plus ferre (to carry). Translation is meaning ferried across the border between languages.
intro.cn: translate 来自拉丁语 translatus（transferre「搬运过去」的不规则过去分词）：trans-（跨越）+ ferre（携带）。翻译就是把意义渡过语言边界。

items.en: ferre meant to carry; trans- added the idea of across.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ferre 意为「携带」，trans- 表示「跨越」。

items.en: transferre meant to carry across; its past form was translatus.
items.cn: transferre 意为「搬运过去」，过去分词为 translatus。

items.en: translatio covered transferring, including the rendering of texts.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 translatio 兼指移转与文本转译。

items.en: English borrowed translate through French in the sense of rendering texts.
items.cn: 英语经法语借入 translate，意为转译文本。

items.en: Extended to codes, effects, and geometric movement.
items.cn: 现代英语扩展到代码、效果与几何平移。

note.en: Words that look or sound close to translate, and words in the carrying-across field.
note.cn: 与 translate 形近音近的词，以及同属「搬运过去」义场的词。

entries.definitionCN: 翻译；译文，translate 的名词形式
译者；译员，translate 的施动名词
translator 的旧式英式拼法，现已少用

entries.definition: to translate speech orally; to explain
entries.definitionCN: 口译；解释，口语翻译多用 interpret

entries.definition: to express in another language or form
entries.definitionCN: 转译；演绎，正式说法
转换；换算，强调形式改变
转述；意译，不换语言只换说法

normalIntro.en: Think of late inside the word: meaning carried late across the border.
normalIntro.cn: 记住词中藏着 late（translatus 的词形）：意义被「迟到地」搬到边界另一头。

normal.cn: trans（跨）+ late（词根形态）＝搬过去
常用搭配 translate into English（译成英语）
译者是 translator，用 -or

normal.en: translate vs interpret: written vs spoken
normal.cn: translate 笔译，interpret 口译
把感受转化为行动是引申用法

abstract.en: A ferry boat carrying a cargo of words across a river
abstract.cn: 渡船载着一舱词语过河

abstract.en: The same melody written down in a new clef
abstract.cn: 同一段旋律用新谱号记下

abstract.en: A figure sliding right across the grid, shape unchanged
abstract.cn: 图形在网格上整体右移，形状不变

examples.en: She translates Japanese detective novels into Chinese.
examples.cn: 她把日本侦探小说译成中文。

examples.en: It is hard to translate enthusiasm into long-term habits.
examples.cn: 热情很难转化为长期的习惯。

examples.en: The word has no exact equivalent when translated.
examples.cn: 这个词翻译过来没有完全对应的说法。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「踹死类特」——翻译就像踹着行李过关：trans（过）+ late（词根），把词句踹过语言的关卡。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（跨越）+ ferre（携带）→ transferre，其过去分词 translatus 独立成词：意义被原样「携带」过界。

sensesIntro.en: From carrying words across languages to converting force, code, and even geometric position.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把词句搬过语言边界，扩展到力量、代码乃至几何位置的转化。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: meaning ferried across a language border
core.cn: 核心意象：意义被渡过语言边界

branches.en: words carried into another language
branches.cn: 词句被搬进另一种语言

branches.en: jargon and code rendered plainly
branches.cn: 术语与代码被转成平实说法

branches.en: pressure or ideas becoming results
branches.cn: 压力或想法变成结果

branches.en: both are meaning preserved while the container changes
branches.cn: 容器变了，意义不变

branches.en: geometry slides objects without changing them
branches.cn: 几何平移不改变对象本身

intro.en: Translate is irregular Latin translatus wearing the trans- prefix; its family all mean carry.
intro.cn: translate 是不规则拉丁词 translatus 戴上 trans- 前缀；其词族都与「携带」有关。

latinIntro.en: The ferre family also gave offer, refer, transfer, and prefer.
latinIntro.cn: ferre 词族还派生了 offer、refer、transfer 与 prefer。

items.meaningCN: 被搬过去的（transferre 过去分词）

items.meaning: to give back in another form

latinEntries.meaning: carried across; past participle of transferre
latinEntries.meaningCN: 被搬运过去的；transferre 的过去分词

definition_zh: 运输；运送；交通工具；运输系统；使激动
definition_en: to carry goods or people from one place to another, or the system that does so
core_image: 一艘货船把集装箱从这片海搬到那片海
scene: 货运码头凌晨装卸完毕，集装箱被吊上开往外地的卡车：The truck driver waited at the port all day just to transport fresh vegetables to the city market on time.
sceneCN: 这里 transport 是动词「运输」（第 1 个义项：把货物运往他处）；句意是司机把蔬菜运到市区市场。

pos.zh: 运输；交通工具；运输系统

collocations.zh: 仿佛置身另一个世界；心驰神往

derivatives.zh: 由 transport 加 -ation 构成，义为「运输；运输系统」
由 transport 加 -er 构成，义为「运输者；运输车」
由 transport 加 -able 构成，义为「可运输的」

senses.title: To carry people or goods from place to place
senses.definition: to take people or goods from one place to another in a vehicle
senses.definitionCN: 用交通工具把人或货物从一地带到另一地
senses.example: The railway transports coal from the north to the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 铁路把煤炭从北方运往海岸。
senses.why: The core image is Latin ferre: a load carried across land or sea.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象正是拉丁语 ferre：货物被携过山海。

senses.title: A system or vehicle for moving people and goods
senses.definition: vehicles or a whole system used for moving people and goods
senses.definitionCN: 用于运送人与货物的车辆或整个体系
senses.example: The city needs better public transport.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市需要更好的公共交通。
senses.why: The act of carrying names both the vehicles and the whole network.
senses.whyCN: 「搬运」这一行为同时命名了车辆与整个网络。

senses.title: To fill someone with strong emotion
senses.definition: to make someone feel extremely happy or excited
senses.definitionCN: 使某人极度喜悦或激动
senses.example: She was transported with joy at the news.
senses.exampleCN: 听到消息，她欣喜若狂。
senses.why: Emotion lifts the heart as if carried away to another place.
senses.whyCN: 情感把心「搬」走，仿佛去了别处。

senses.title: To send a criminal overseas as punishment
senses.definition: to send a criminal abroad as a former legal punishment
senses.definitionCN: 旧时把罪犯流放海外的刑罚
senses.example: Convicts were once transported to distant colonies.
senses.exampleCN: 罪犯曾被流放到遥远的殖民地。
senses.why: The same carrying across, done to a body and against its will.
senses.whyCN: 同样的「搬运过界」，只是对象是人且违背其意愿。

intro.en: Transport comes from Latin transportare, to carry across, from trans- (across) plus portare (to carry). English took the noun stress in front and the verb stress behind.
intro.cn: transport 来自拉丁语 transportare「搬运过去」：trans-（跨越）+ portare（搬运）。英语名词重音在前，动词重音在后。

items.en: portare meant to carry, seen in port and portable.
items.cn: 拉丁语 portare 意为「搬运」，见于 port 与 portable。

items.en: transportare meant to carry across or remove.
items.cn: 拉丁语 transportare 意为「搬过去、移走」。

items.en: Borrowed into English for carrying goods and feelings alike.
items.cn: 进入英语时兼指运送货物与激荡情感。

items.en: The penal sense of sending convicts overseas was common.
items.cn: 17–18 世纪流放罪犯的刑罚义很常见。

items.en: Now centred on moving people, goods, and systems.
items.cn: 现代用法集中于人员、货物的运送及运输系统。

note.en: Words that look or sound close to transport, and words in the carrying field.
note.cn: 与 transport 形近音近的词，以及同属「搬运」义场的词。

entries.definition: the American term for transport systems
entries.definitionCN: （美）运输；运输系统，transport 的名词派生

entries.definition: a vehicle or device that transports
entries.definitionCN: 运输车；运输者，transport 的施动名词
便携的，与 transport 共享 portare（搬运）词根
携带；搬运，最普通的说法
运送；传达，偏正式
通行；运输途中，强调过程
一批货运，强调货物本身

normalIntro.en: Keep the two stresses: TRANSport is the thing, transPORT is the act.
normalIntro.cn: 记住双重音：TRANSport 是名词（交通工具），transPORT 是动词（运送）。

senses.title: The act or business of transporting goods and people

senses.why: The core image is the Latin act of carrying across, turned into a business.

senses.title: The systems and vehicles used for moving people

senses.title: The fare or means by which one travels

intro.en: Transportation is transport plus the Latin noun suffix -ation, a making of the act into a name. Both verb and noun descend from Latin transportare, to carry across.

items.en: portare meant to carry; trans- meant across.
items.cn: 拉丁语 portare 意为「搬运」，trans- 表示「跨越」。

items.en: transportare meant to carry across.
items.cn: 拉丁语 transportare 意为「搬运过去」。

items.en: Transport entered English for carrying goods and persons.
items.cn: transport 进入英语，指运送货物与人。

items.en: Transportation was formed as the action noun.
items.cn: transportation 作为动作名词被构造出来。

entries.definition: the carrying of goods; old word for vehicle
entries.definitionCN: 货运；四轮马车（旧），旧式说法

normalIntro.en: Transportation is transport wearing the long -ation robe.

abstract.en: A thousand trucks rolling out of a port at dawn
abstract.cn: 黎明时千辆卡车驶出港口

abstract.en: Coins dropped into a fare box before boarding

examples.cn: 她的工作是给全县做交通规划。

sensesIntro.en: The act of carrying became a business, a network, and finally the ride itself.

definition_en: things that are thrown away as worthless, or to discard or wreck something
core_image: 被揉皱扔进纸篓的草稿：写过即弃的东西

senses.title: Things thrown away as worthless

senses.definitionCN: 人们因无用而丢弃的东西
