senses.exampleCN: 空瓶子和其他垃圾堆在一起。
senses.why: The core image is paper crumpled and dropped into the bin.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是被揉皱丢进纸篓的纸团。

senses.title: Something of very poor quality
senses.definition: something of very bad quality or value
senses.definitionCN: 质量或价值极差的东西
senses.example: That film is pure trash, two hours wasted.
senses.exampleCN: 那部电影就是彻头彻尾的垃圾片，浪费了两小时。
senses.why: Worthless things end up with the worthless things thrown away.
senses.whyCN: 无价值之物与被丢弃之物归为一处。

senses.title: Nonsense or foolish talk
senses.definition: talk or writing that is silly or worthless
senses.definitionCN: 愚蠢或毫无价值的言语
senses.example: Everything he said that night was complete trash.
senses.exampleCN: 他那晚说的全是胡话。
senses.why: Words with no value are trash for the ears.
senses.whyCN: 没有价值的言语是耳朵里的垃圾。

senses.title: To discard, wreck, or attack
senses.definition: to throw away, destroy, or criticize severely
senses.definitionCN: 丢弃、毁坏或严厉批评
senses.example: The fans trashed the stadium after the loss.
senses.exampleCN: 输球之后球迷把体育场捣毁了。
senses.why: Treating a thing as trash means treating it roughly and finally.
senses.whyCN: 把某物当垃圾，就是对它下狠手、不留余地。

intro.en: Trash first appeared in Middle English meaning the twigs and cuttings broken off in forest work; its further origin is uncertain. The sense slid to refuse, then to anything worthless.
intro.cn: trash 最早见于中古英语，指林事中折下的枝条碎料，更早词源不确定。词义滑向废弃物，再滑向一切无价值之物。

items.en: Recorded as trash meaning cuttings or broken twigs from trees.
items.cn: 中古英语记作 trash，意为剪下的枝条或断枝。

items.en: The deeper origin is unknown; suggestions exist but none is accepted.
items.cn: 更早词源不明，有若干假说但均未被公认。

items.en: The meaning moved to household refuse and worthless things.
items.cn: 16 世纪词义转向家庭垃圾与无价值之物。

items.en: Applied to poor-quality literature and to nonsense speech.

items.en: The verb developed senses of wrecking and harsh criticism.

definition_en: to go from one place to another, especially over a distance, or such journeys in general
core_image: 车轮后不断后退的风景：人始终在两个地方之间

senses.title: To go from one place to another, especially far
senses.definition: to make a journey, especially a long one over distance
senses.definitionCN: 作一次旅程，尤指长距离的
senses.example: They travelled across five countries in one summer.
senses.exampleCN: 他们一个夏天穿越了五个国家。
senses.why: The core image is scenery sliding backwards while you move between places.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是风景后退而你始终在两地之间移动。

senses.title: To move or be carried from place to place
senses.definition: to move or be moved from one place to another
senses.definitionCN: 从一个地方移动或被移到另一个地方
senses.example: Light travels faster than sound.
senses.exampleCN: 光比声音传得快。
senses.why: What crosses the distance need not be a person; light and sound travel too.
senses.whyCN: 跨越距离的不一定是人，光与声音也会「旅行」。

senses.title: To spread from place to place
senses.definition: to spread from one place or person to others
senses.definitionCN: 从一个地方或人蔓延到其他地方
senses.example: The disease travelled quickly along the trade routes.
senses.exampleCN: 疾病沿着商路迅速传播。
senses.why: Whatever walks the roads will reach the towns along them.
senses.whyCN: 凡沿路而行的，终会抵达沿途的城镇。

senses.title: Journeys made in general; the experience of travelling
senses.definition: journeys considered together, or the experience they give
senses.definitionCN: 把多次旅程合在一起看，或旅程带来的体验
senses.example: His travels in Africa changed his whole outlook.
senses.exampleCN: 他在非洲的游历改变了他整个人生观。
senses.why: Many single journeys gather into one travelling life.
senses.whyCN: 一次次单独的旅程汇成一段游历人生。

intro.en: Travel descends from travail, hardship, from a Roman instrument of torture called a tripalium, a frame of three stakes. To travel was once to toil painfully; the word softened as roads improved.
intro.cn: travel 源自 travail「苦役、辛劳」，一般认为出自罗马刑具 tripalium（三根木桩构成的架子）。travel 本义是痛苦劳作，道路改善后词义才柔化为「旅行」。

items.en: tripalium named a torture frame of three stakes.
items.cn: 一般认为 tripalium 指三根木桩做成的刑具架。

items.en: travaillier meant to toil, suffer, or labour painfully.
items.cn: 古法语 travaillier 意为「劳作、受苦」。

items.en: travail meant painful effort; travel was the same word.
items.cn: 中古英语 travail 指艰辛努力，travel 与之同为一词。

items.en: The spellings split: travail kept hardship, travel took the journey.
items.cn: 两种拼写分化：travail 保留艰辛义，travel 专指旅程。

items.en: Travel now covers people, light, disease, and ideas on the move.
items.cn: 现代 travel 涵盖人、光、疾病与观念的移动。

examples.en: News travels fast in a small town.
examples.cn: 小城镇里消息传得飞快。

examples.en: Her travels through Asia lasted two years.
examples.cn: 她在亚洲的游历持续了两年。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「踹维奥」——古人出远门像被踹着受刑一样辛苦：travel 与 travail（受苦）同源，踹着木头架子去远方。

root: 一般认为源自晚期拉丁语 tripalium（三桩刑具）→ 古法语 travaillier「受苦劳作」→ 中古英语 travail/travel 同词异拼，后分化：一个指艰辛，一个指旅程。

sensesIntro.en: From painful labour on bad roads, the word eased into journeys, movement, and even light and rumours travelling.
sensesIntro.cn: 从烂路上的苦役渐变为旅程与移动，连光与传闻也会 travel。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: scenery sliding backwards between two places
core.cn: 核心意象：两地之间不断后退的风景

branches.en: a person making a journey
branches.cn: 人作一次旅程

branches.en: anything moving across distance
branches.cn: 任何跨越距离的移动

branches.en: disease or news spreading along routes
branches.cn: 疾病或消息沿路线传播

branches.en: the same word carries both walkers and light
branches.cn: 同一个词既承载行人也承载光

branches.en: many journeys become one travelled life
branches.cn: 多次旅程汇成一段游历人生

intro.en: Travel has no classical affixes; its family is French and late Latin, born of hardship.
intro.cn: travel 不含古典词缀，词族属法语与晚期拉丁语，生于艰辛。

latinIntro.en: Travel has no classical Latin relatives in common use; its source word tripalium died out.
latinIntro.cn: travel 在古典拉丁语中没有常用同族词，其来源词 tripalium 已消亡。

items.meaning: a film or talk about travels

latinEntries.meaning: a frame of three stakes; an instrument of torture
latinEntries.meaningCN: 三桩之架；刑具（一般认为）

definition_zh: 托盘；盘子；浅盘；文件盘；沙盘
definition_en: a flat, shallow container with a raised edge for carrying or holding things
core_image: 托在腕上的浅盘：四边微微翘起，稳稳托住一切
scene: 食堂打饭窗口前，同学们端着空盘子依次排队：At the canteen window students carried trays full of food, queuing slowly towards the till.
sceneCN: 这里 tray 是「托盘」（第 1 个义项：带边沿的浅盘）；句意是学生端着装饭菜的餐盘排队。

derivatives.zh: 由 tray 加 -ful 构成，义为「一盘之量」（罕用）
由 ash 加 tray 构成，义为「烟灰缸」
与 tray 常搭配的名词短语，义为「点心烤盘」

senses.title: A flat shallow container with a raised rim
senses.definition: a flat piece of material with raised edges, used for carrying or holding things
senses.definitionCN: 边缘翘起的扁平容器，用于托举或盛放
senses.example: The waiter balanced a tray of drinks above the crowd.
senses.exampleCN: 侍者把盛满饮料的托盘稳稳举过人群。
senses.why: The core image is a shallow plate with lifted edges holding everything steady.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是四边翘起的浅盘，把一切稳稳托住。

senses.title: An open compartment for papers or small items
senses.definition: an open container on a desk or in a machine for papers or parts
senses.definitionCN: 桌上或机器里放文件或小件的敞口容器
senses.example: Letters for signature wait in the in tray on her desk.
senses.exampleCN: 待签的信件躺在她桌上的收文盘里。
senses.why: The rim that once held drinks now holds papers and parts.
senses.whyCN: 当年托住饮料的边沿，如今托住文件与零件。

senses.title: A tray used in cooking or science
senses.definition: a flat metal dish for baking, or a shallow dish for laboratory work
senses.definitionCN: 烘烤用的扁平金属盘，或实验室用的浅盘
senses.example: Line the baking tray with paper before the cookies go in.
senses.exampleCN: 饼干入炉前先在烤盘上铺纸。
senses.why: Wherever things must be carried flat and level, a tray appears.
senses.whyCN: 凡需水平平稳盛放之物，便有 tray 的用武之地。

intro.en: Tray comes from Old English treg, træg, a wooden board or runner, related to tree and timber; the shallow board for holding things became the tray.
intro.cn: tray 来自古英语 treg/træg「木板、滑条」，与 tree、timber 同族；承物的浅木板遂成今日的托盘。

items.en: treg or træg meant a wooden board or slope-shaped runner.
items.cn: 古英语 treg/træg 意为木板或斜面滑条。

items.en: Generally related to the Germanic word family of tree and timber.
items.cn: 一般认为属日耳曼语族 tree、timber 词族。

items.en: tray named shallow boards for carrying food.
items.cn: 中古英语 tray 指端送食物的浅木板。

items.en: Extended to desks, machines, ovens, and laboratories.
items.cn: 扩展到书桌、机器、烤箱与实验室。

items.en: Now covers kitchens, offices, banks of machines, and more.
items.cn: 现代用法涵盖厨房、办公室与各类设备。

note.en: Words that look or sound close to tray, and words in the holding field.
note.cn: 与 tray 形近音近的词，以及同属承放义场的词。

entries.definition: the colour between black and white
entries.definitionCN: 灰色，与 tray 押韵但词源无关
祈祷，与 tray 发音相近（美式更近）但词源不同

entries.definition: a small tray for cigarette ash
entries.definitionCN: 烟灰缸，tray 的常见复合词

entries.definition: a flat dish for one person
entries.definitionCN: 盘子；碟，个人用餐的浅器
碟；盘菜，泛指盛食物的器皿

entries.definition: a small dish under a cup
entries.definitionCN: 茶碟，置于杯下的浅盘

entries.definition: a deep container with a handle
entries.definitionCN: 桶，与 tray 相对：深而有柄 vs 浅而无柄

normalIntro.en: Hear tray rhyme with way: the flat way things are carried.
normalIntro.cn: tray 与 way 押韵：货物被平平稳稳托起的「方式」。

normal.en: tray rhymes with way, grey, pay
normal.cn: tray 与 way、grey、pay 同韵
常用搭配：烤盘、收文盘
ashtray＝烟灰缸，烟灰的小托盘

normal.en: a tray has raised edges to hold things
normal.cn: 托盘的边沿翘起才能托住东西

normal.en: in tray vs out tray in offices
normal.cn: 办公室的收文盘与发文盘

abstract.en: A waiter gliding through a crowd, one hand high
abstract.cn: 侍者一手高举托盘穿行人群

abstract.en: Paper stacked flat in two wooden office trays
abstract.cn: 文件平平地码在两只木文件盘里

abstract.en: Cookies spreading out on a warm baking sheet
abstract.cn: 饼干摊在温热的烤盘上

examples.en: She carried the tea set on a silver tray.
examples.cn: 她用银托盘端着整套茶具。

examples.en: New orders pile up in his in tray every morning.
examples.cn: 每天早上新订单都堆满他的收文盘。

examples.en: Grease the tray before pouring in the batter.
examples.cn: 倒面糊前先给烤盘抹油。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「踹」——手端托盘被人一踹就洒：踹！端稳你的 tray。与 way 押韵，托盘平得像一条 way（路）。

root: 古英语 treg/træg「木板、滑条」，一般认为与 tree、timber 同族：一块承物之板，边缘微翘，便是 tray。

sensesIntro.en: From a wooden board for carrying food, the word slid onto desks, into machines, and into ovens.
sensesIntro.cn: 从端送食物的木板滑上书桌、钻进机器、进入烤箱。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a shallow board with raised edges holding everything steady
core.cn: 核心意象：边缘翘起、稳稳托住一切的浅板

branches.en: food or drink carried on a flat base
branches.cn: 以平底承托的食物饮品

branches.en: papers or parts held in open compartments
branches.cn: 敞口格盘里的文件与零件

branches.en: the oven tray and lab dish
branches.cn: 烤箱烤盘与实验浅盘

branches.en: the raised edge is what makes a tray a tray
branches.cn: 翘起的边沿正是 tray 的本质

branches.en: wherever flat holding is needed, trays multiply
branches.cn: 凡需平放之物处，盘必滋生

intro.en: Tray is a short native word; its family is compounds rather than affixes.
intro.cn: tray 是简短的本土词，其词族以复合词为主而非词缀。

latinIntro.en: Tray has no Latin relatives; it belongs to the Germanic tree/timber family.
latinIntro.cn: tray 没有拉丁同族词，属日耳曼语 tree/timber 词族。

a small dish under a cup
a desk tray for incoming work

definition_zh: 对待；治疗；处理；招待；请客；乐事
definition_en: to behave towards someone or something in a stated way, or to try to cure illness
core_image: 医生俯身查看伤口：无论对待、治疗还是请客，都是「按某方式接手处理」
scene: 孩子考了满分，妈妈笑着说今晚带他去吃大餐：The nurse cleaned the wound gently and promised him a candy as a little treat, and the child stopped crying at once.
sceneCN: 这里 treat 是动词「对待；安慰」（第 5 个义项：请客、给予款待）；句意是护士用糖安慰孩子。

pos.zh: 请客；款待；乐事；难得的享受

collocations.zh: 难得的乐事；大快朵颐之乐

derivatives.zh: 由 treat 加 -ment 构成，义为「治疗；待遇；处理」
由 treat 加 -y 构成，义为「条约；协议」
由动词加 -er 构成，义为「处理者；治疗者」（罕用）

senses.title: To behave towards someone or something in a way
senses.definition: to act or behave towards a person or thing in the stated way
senses.definitionCN: 以所述方式待人或待物
senses.example: The firm treats every small client with the same respect.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司对所有小客户一视同仁。
senses.why: The core image is how hands hold something: roughly or gently, that is treating.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是手握物的姿态：或粗鲁或轻柔，这就是对待。

senses.title: To try to cure a sick person or wound
senses.definition: to give medical care to a person, wound, or illness
senses.definitionCN: 对人、伤口或疾病进行医疗护理
senses.example: Doctors treated her burn within the hour.
senses.exampleCN: 医生在一小时内处理了她的烧伤。
senses.why: A doctor takes hold of an injury the way hands take hold of a thing.
senses.whyCN: 医生接手伤病，正如双手接住一件东西。

senses.title: To put a substance through a process
senses.definition: to subject something to a chemical or physical process
senses.definitionCN: 使某物经受化学或物理处理
senses.example: The factory treats its wastewater before release.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂在排放前先处理废水。
senses.why: Handling a material to change it is the industrial sense of the image.
senses.whyCN: 对材料动手使其改变，即该意象的工业用法。

senses.title: To provide food or fun at your own cost
senses.definition: to buy or provide something enjoyable for others at your own expense
senses.definitionCN: 自掏腰包为他人提供食物或乐趣
senses.example: It is my birthday, so lunch is my treat.
senses.exampleCN: 今天我生日，午饭我请客。
senses.why: Holding out something nice to someone is a generous way of treating.
senses.whyCN: 向人递出好东西，是「接手」最慷慨的形态。

senses.title: A special pleasure that is unusual
senses.definition: something pleasant and unusual, especially a small surprise pleasure
senses.definitionCN: 令人愉快且不寻常的事，尤指小小惊喜
senses.example: A hot spring after the hike was a real treat.
senses.exampleCN: 远足后的温泉真是难得的享受。
senses.why: What is handed to you without asking becomes a delight.
senses.whyCN: 不期而至的馈赠便是乐事。

intro.en: Treat comes from Old French traitier, from Latin tractare, to handle or drag about, a frequentative of trahere, to pull. To treat is to keep handling.
intro.cn: treat 来自古法语 traitier，出自拉丁语 tractare「反复拉拽、处理」，是 trahere「拉」的反复动词。treat 的本义就是「不断上手处理」。

items.en: trahere meant to pull or drag, the root of trace and train.
items.cn: 拉丁语 trahere 意为「拉、曳」，是 trace、train 的词根。

items.en: tractare, its frequentative, meant to handle repeatedly.
items.cn: 其反复动词 tractare 意为「反复处理、摆弄」。

items.en: traitier meant to negotiate, handle, or deal with.
items.cn: 古法语 traitier 意为「谈判、处理、对待」。

items.en: Borrowed with senses of negotiation and conduct.
items.cn: 进入英语时兼有谈判与行事之义。

items.en: Senses settled on conduct, medicine, industry, and hospitality.
items.cn: 词义固定于待人、医疗、工业加工与待客。

note.en: Words that look or sound close to treat, and words in the handling field.
note.cn: 与 treat 形近音近的词，以及同属「处理」义场的词。

entries.definitionCN: 条约，treat 加 -y 的名词，谈判（treat）的结果

entries.definition: the act or way of treating
entries.definitionCN: 治疗；待遇，treat 加 -ment 的名词
威胁，与 treat 只是元音长短之差，拼写一误便变义
处理；应对，与 treat 的本义最接近
治愈，强调结果而非过程
招待；款待，偏宴请与娱乐
处理；应对，口语常用短语

normalIntro.en: Remember tractare: treat means handling again and again.
normalIntro.cn: 记住 tractare：treat 就是一遍遍上手处理。

normal.en: treat comes from tractare = handle repeatedly
normal.cn: treat 源自「反复处理」的拉丁词

normal.en: one word: treat people, wounds, water, guests
normal.cn: 一个词管四件事：待人、治伤、净水、请客

normal.en: collocation: my treat, a real treat
normal.cn: 常用搭配：我请客、难得乐事

normal.en: watch out for threat, not treat
normal.cn: 小心 threat（威胁），别写成 treat

normal.en: treatment, treaty come from the same root
normal.cn: treatment（治疗）、treaty（条约）同根

abstract.en: A doctor's hands gently turning a wounded arm
abstract.cn: 医生的手轻轻托住受伤的手臂

abstract.en: A host pushing the best seat towards a guest
abstract.cn: 主人把最好的座位让向客人

abstract.en: Factory water running clean out of the final pipe
abstract.cn: 处理过的清水从工厂末道管口流出

examples.en: The clinic treats more than a hundred patients a day.
examples.cn: 这家诊所每天治疗上百名病人。

examples.en: Parents should treat children's questions seriously.
examples.cn: 父母应认真对待孩子的提问。

examples.en: Ice cream after dinner was our little treat.
examples.cn: 饭后一支冰淇淋是我们的小确幸。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吹特」——医生吹一吹伤口再上药：吹特→treat，吹着口気温柔地处理。treat、treatment、treaty 一家三口。

root: 拉丁语 trahere「拉」的反复动词 tractare「反复处理」→ 古法语 traitier「对待、谈判」→ 英语 treat：无论治疗、加工还是请客，核心都是「上手处理」。

sensesIntro.en: From handling things again and again, the word covers conduct, cures, industry, and generosity.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「反复上手处理」延伸到待人、医疗、工业与慷慨待客。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: hands taking hold of something to deal with it
core.cn: 核心意象：双手接住某物并着手处理

branches.en: the way you act towards others
branches.cn: 待人处世的方式

branches.en: medical care for the sick
branches.cn: 对病人的医疗处置

branches.en: chemical or industrial processing
branches.cn: 化学或工业加工

branches.en: good treatment of people often becomes a treat
branches.cn: 善待常以「款待」收尾

branches.en: both doctor and factory take hold and change what they hold
branches.cn: 医生与工厂都是先接住、再改变

intro.en: Treat keeps the Latin frequentative tractare, the same pulling root as train and trace.
intro.cn: treat 保留了拉丁反复动词 tractare，与 train、trace 共享「拉曳」词根。

latinIntro.en: Latin trahere also gave extract, subtract, contract, and trail-words.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 trahere 还派生了 extract、subtract、contract 等词。
